abstract: ABSTRACT Background Shift work, or working outside of normal circadian cycles, is associated with both experience of fatigue and poorer long-term physical and mental health. However, current methods for assessing fatigue present several barriers to building understanding of how these risks develop over time within individuals. Objective Here, we explore the potential of momentary speech activity-based fatigue measurement in a large, multi-lingual cohort of shift workers, using an intensive longitudinal study design (twice-daily measurement over two weeks in N =1,197 individuals from six different countries). Methods Paralinguistic speech features were used to predict different aspects of acute and chronic fatigue at each study time-point, with performance assessed in unseen (held-out) data. Results are reported both across the dataset as a whole, and for user-specific prediction models. Findings In the cross-sectional analysis, good (close to or exceeding current state-of-the-art) performance was achieved for both current sleep deprivation and self-reported sleepiness levels. The within-user analysis revealed robust increases in performance, yielding the ability to detect more subjective aspects of fatigue such as pervasive physical and mental exhaustion. Conclusions These findings offer preliminary support for the utility of using brief momentary speech samples as a low-burden, acceptable, and reliable measure of different aspects of fatigue in high-risk populations such as shift workers. Clinical Implications Developing brief, accessible measures of different dimensions of fatigue is an important step towards building understanding of how risks for poorer health outcomes develop over time within individuals exposed to significant circadian disruption. Summary What is already known on this topic Previous studies have indicated that speech data may be a promising source of information about fatigue: however to date these have primarily been carried out in small, unrepresentative samples and in non-naturalistic settings, making results hard to generalize. What this study adds Here, we present evidence from a large international study where participants both provided momentary speech activity data and reported levels of different aspects of fatigue, as they went about their usual working lives. zh_abstract: 【摘要】【背景】轮班工作，即在正常昼夜节律周期之外工作，与疲劳体验以及较差的长期身心健康相关。然而，目前评估疲劳的方法存在若干障碍，难以了解这些风险如何在个体内随时间发展。【目的】本研究采用密集纵向研究设计（在来自六个不同国家的 N = 1,197 名个体中，两周内每日测量两次），探索基于即时语音活动的疲劳测量在大型多语言轮班工作者队列中的潜力。【方法】利用副语言语音特征预测每个研究时间点上急性和慢性疲劳的不同方面，并在未见过（留出）的数据中评估性能。结果既报告整个数据集的情况，也报告针对用户个体的预测模型。【结果】在横断面分析中，对于当前睡眠剥夺和自我报告的嗜睡程度均取得了良好的性能（接近或超过目前的最先进水平）。个体内分析显示性能显著提升，能够检测疲劳中更主观的方面，如普遍存在的身体和精神衰竭。【结论】这些发现初步支持将简短的即时语音样本作为一种低负担、可接受且可靠的方法，用于测量轮班工作者等高风险人群疲劳的不同方面。【临床意义】开发简短、易获取的疲劳不同维度的测量方法，是了解暴露于显著昼夜节律紊乱的个体其不良健康结局风险如何随时间发展的重要一步。【摘要要点】关于该主题已知的内容：既往研究表明，语音数据可能是有关疲劳的有前景的信息来源；然而迄今这些研究主要在小规模、缺乏代表性的样本和非自然情境中进行，使结果难以推广。本研究的新增内容：我们提供了一项大型国际研究的证据，参与者在日常工作生活中既提供即时语音活动数据，又报告疲劳不同方面的水平。重要的是，我们采用的建模框架明确考虑了年龄、性别和语言等因素对语音特征和目标的潜在影响

abstract: There is an urgent global need for affordable, large-scale health screening to enhance preventive care in the ageing population. Using low-cost, non-invasive retinal photographs and leveraging large foundation models, we developed a deep learning-based biomarker, Retinal Mortality Equivalent (RetiME), that directly mapped retinal features to individual mortality risk. Trained on a European cohort and externally validated across three independent external cohorts spanning Southeast Asia, Eurasia and North America, RetiME showed robust associations with all-cause and cause-specific mortality and predicted the incidence of a wide range of systemic and ocular diseases. Crucially, beyond static risk estimation, RetiME re-timed mortality risk by reconstructing personalized lifespan trajectories that were associated with observed mortality outcomes (for example, age of death). Clustering of these trajectories revealed distinct mortality patterns, spanning cancer-predominant, cardiometabolic and neurodegenerative risks, reflecting diverse ageing pathways captured by RetiME. Interpretability analyses showed that RetiME captures diverse biological and retinal features underlying mortality risk. Genome-wide analyses further identified genetic loci associated with RetiME. Collectively, these findings support further evaluation of retinal imaging and trajectory modelling as one component of a comprehensive assessment of mortality risk.
zh_abstract: 全球迫切需要经济实惠、大规模的健康筛查，以加强老龄人口的预防性医疗。我们利用低成本、无创的视网膜照片，并借助大型基础模型，开发了一种基于深度学习的生物标志物——视网膜死亡当量（Retinal Mortality Equivalent，RetiME），可将视网膜特征直接映射为个体死亡风险。RetiME 在一个欧洲队列中训练，并在涵盖东南亚、欧亚地区和北美的三个独立外部队列中进行了外部验证，结果显示其与全因死亡及特定原因死亡均有稳健的关联，并可预测多种全身性疾病和眼部疾病的发生。关键的是，除静态风险估计外，RetiME 还通过重建个体化寿命轨迹对死亡风险进行了“重新定时”，这些轨迹与观察到的死亡结局（例如死亡年龄）相关。对这些轨迹进行聚类，揭示了不同的死亡模式，涵盖以癌症为主、心血管代谢以及神经退行性风险，反映了 RetiME 所捕捉到的多样化衰老路径。可解释性分析显示，RetiME 捕捉了与死亡风险相关的多种生物学和视网膜特征。全基因组分析进一步鉴定出与 RetiME 相关的遗传位点。总体而言，这些发现支持进一步评估视网膜成像和轨迹建模，将其作为死亡风险综合评估的组成部分之一。

abstract: Patients often arrive at brief, time-constrained clinical visits unsure of what to expect or ask, and millions of adults now turn to general-purpose AI chatbots to prepare beforehand. Yet whether conversational AI improves visit readiness remains unclear. We designed a large language model (LLM)-based visit preparation agent to guide patients before an appointment by gathering clinical context, setting visit expectations, providing relevant health information, building a prioritized list of questions for their clinician, and generating a summary. In a prospective consented randomized study in the Google Health app, 802 U.S. adults held 866 health-related conversations with the visit preparation agent (standard or concise variant) or a minimally prompted control chatbot built on the same LLM. The visit preparation agent significantly outperformed the control across blinded clinician evaluations and patient self-reports. In clinician reviews of completed sessions (n = 272), the agent achieved a 16.6% higher rate of comprehensive preparation (67.2% vs. 50.6%; P < 0.05) and an 8.5% higher rate of alignment with patients' health context (98.9% vs. 90.4%; P < 0.01), while maintaining high medical safety and appropriateness across all study arms. Patient post-surveys (n = 460) showed 16.8% higher visit preparedness (73.8% vs. 57.0%; P < 0.01), 14.3% higher confidence in knowing what to ask (81.4% vs. 67.1%; P < 0.01), and 12.0% higher overall satisfaction (74.0% vs. 62.0%; P < 0.05). Clinician and participant metrics were not significantly correlated, indicating that expert review and patient self-assessment capture complementary dimensions of patient-facing AI. These findings suggest that LLM chatbots can safely help patients prepare for clinical visits, with greater benefit when following a structured workflow, and motivate future studies on in-visit communication and clinical outcomes.

abstract: [Diagnostic and interventional radiology (Ankara, Turkey)] Artificial intelligence (AI) in radiology remains predominantly examination-centric, whereas clinical interpretation frequently depends on comparison across time or with relevant prior cases. This narrative review examines comparative reasoning in radiology AI through two related but clinically distinct forms: longitudinal reasoning, which compares examinations from the same patient over time, and reference-case reasoning, which uses clinically analogous cases from other patients to support interpretation. We propose a capability hierarchy that distinguishes simple access to comparative information from higher-level capabilities, including selection of relevant historical context, anatomical and lesion-level correspondence, characterization of interval change, temporal-state interpretation, multi-interval trajectory reasoning, and entity-specific assessment of clinical similarity. This distinction matters because providing prior examinations or retrieving visually similar cases does not itself demonstrate meaningful comparative reasoning. We review developments in prior-examination selection, registration, lesion tracking, temporal vision-language modeling, treatment-response assessment, analogous-case retrieval, and longitudinal report generation. Particular emphasis is placed on evaluation strategies that determine whether model performance depends appropriately on clinically relevant comparative information rather than on additional input volume, global image similarity, acquisition characteristics, or other shortcuts. Key challenges include incorrect prior selection, lesion mismatching, temporal inconsistency, clinically irrelevant reference-case retrieval, data leakage, misleading comparative language, and propagation of historical errors. Future progress will require models that preserve entity identity, reason coherently across multi-visit imaging histories, identify clinically informative reference cases, and demonstrate benefit under realistic clinical conditions. Comparative reasoning is therefore a necessary step in the transition from examination-level toward patient-level radiology AI.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostic and interventional radiology (Ankara, Turkey)] 放射学中的人工智能（AI）仍以检查为中心，而临床解读往往依赖于跨时间或与相关既往病例的比较。本叙述性综述通过两种相关但临床上不同的形式来探讨放射学AI中的比较推理：纵向推理，即比较同一患者不同时间的检查；以及参照病例推理，即利用其他患者的临床类似病例辅助解读。我们提出一个能力层级，将对比较信息的简单获取与更高层次的能力区分开来，后者包括相关历史背景的选择、解剖与病灶层面的对应、间期变化的表征、时间状态解读、多间期轨迹推理，以及针对特定实体的临床相似性评估。这一区分之所以重要，是因为提供既往检查或检索视觉相似病例本身并不能证明存在有意义的比较推理。我们综述了既往检查选择、配准、病灶追踪、时序视觉-语言建模、治疗反应评估、类似病例检索和纵向报告生成方面的进展。我们特别强调这样的评估策略：用以确定模型性能是否恰当地依赖于临床相关的比较信息，而非额外的输入量、全局图像相似性、采集特征或其他捷径。主要挑战包括既往检查选择错误、病灶错配、时间不一致、检索到临床无关的参照病例、数据泄露、具有误导性的比较性语言以及历史错误的传播。未来的进展将需要这样的模型：保持实体身份、在多次就诊的影像历史中进行连贯推理、识别具有临床信息价值的参照病例，并在真实临床条件下证明其获益。因此，比较推理是放射学AI从检查水平向患者水平过渡的必要一步。

abstract: [Cureus] Rising imaging workload and a shortage of radiology specialists have driven interest in artificial intelligence (AI) to improve diagnostic speed and accuracy. This systematic review, without meta-analysis, describes how AI affects diagnostic accuracy and operational efficiency compared with human interpretation in diagnostic radiology. Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA 2020) and Cochrane guidance, PubMed, ClinicalKey, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar were searched on 11 April 2026 for studies published from January 2019 onwards. Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and a Quality Assessment of Diagnostic Accuracy Studies 2 (QUADAS-2)-based risk-of-bias assessment. Twenty-one studies were included: 11 compared standalone AI with human readers, six compared AI-assisted with unassisted readers, and four reported both; 18 evaluated task-specific image-analysis AI and three evaluated generative AI models. Because no subgroup was homogeneous enough to pool, we synthesised results narratively and stratified them by comparison type, AI category, imaging modality, and study quality. Standalone image-analysis AI achieved high sensitivity for fractures and selected chest findings but performed less well on subtle findings and lower-quality images, and in one computed tomography-referenced comparison a radiologist outperformed AI. AI assistance improved reader performance more consistently, particularly among less experienced readers. Generative models did not reach specialist performance on complex tasks. Efficiency gains were concentrated in normal studies, and the only randomised trial found lower mammography screen-reading workload with similar early screening performance. No study assessed patient outcomes, and 18 of 21 studies were retrospective. This evidence supports AI only as a supervised, complementary tool; improvements in diagnostic accuracy should not be equated with clinical benefit.
zh_abstract: [Cureus] 影像工作量不断增加以及放射科专科医师短缺，促使人们关注利用人工智能（AI）来提高诊断速度和准确性。本系统综述（不含荟萃分析）描述了在诊断放射学中，与人工判读相比，AI 如何影响诊断准确性和运行效率。遵循系统综述和荟萃分析优先报告条目（PRISMA 2020）及 Cochrane 指南，于 2026 年 4 月 11 日检索了 PubMed、ClinicalKey、ScienceDirect 和 Google Scholar，纳入 2019 年 1 月及之后发表的研究。两名评价者独立完成研究筛选、数据提取，以及基于诊断准确性研究质量评价工具 2（QUADAS-2）的偏倚风险评估。共纳入 21 项研究：11 项比较了独立运行的 AI 与人类阅片者，6 项比较了有 AI 辅助与无辅助的阅片者，4 项两者均有报告；18 项评估了针对特定任务的图像分析 AI，3 项评估了生成式 AI 模型。由于没有任何亚组同质性足以进行合并，我们采用叙述性方式综合结果，并按比较类型、AI 类别、影像模态和研究质量分层。独立运行的图像分析 AI 对骨折和部分胸部征象具有较高的敏感性，但对细微征象和较低质量图像的表现较差，并且在一项以计算机断层扫描为参照的比较中，放射科医师的表现优于 AI。AI 辅助对阅片者表现的改善更为一致，尤其是在经验较少的阅片者中。生成式模型在复杂任务上未达到专科医师水平。效率提升集中在正常检查上，唯一的随机试验发现乳腺 X 线筛查阅片工作量降低，而早期筛查表现相近。没有研究评估患者结局，21 项研究中有 18 项为回顾性研究。该证据仅支持将 AI 作为受监督的辅助工具；不应将诊断准确性的提高等同于临床获益。

abstract: [European heart journal] External validation involving the testing of a frozen AI model on independent data from other sites, populations, time periods, or devices provides the clearest estimate of intended-use setting performance when those external data are deployment-representative of the expected population, measurement processes, and clinical workflow. It yields realistic estimates of discrimination and calibration, exposes shortcut learning and distribution shift, quantifies clinical utility through decision-analytic measures, and reveals subgroup disparities requiring mitigation. Yet common pitfalls undermine credibility: quasi-external splits with hidden relatedness; spectrum and prevalence mismatch; site, workflow, and hardware effects; label noise and reference-standard drift; analytic flexibility and selective reporting; small, underpowered samples; reliance only on the area under the curve; unreported threshold tuning; and leakage. A practical blueprint emphasizes pre-registration; representative, multi-site cohorts spanning geography, time, and acquisition; prevention of patient and temporal overlap; comprehensive evaluation of discrimination, calibration (including calibration-in-the-large, calibration slope, and calibration plots), and net benefit with confidence intervals; pre-specified subgroup and fairness audits; transparent labelling procedures and uncertainty analyses; principled sample-size calculations; and minimal, well-documented model updating (recalibration before revision). Finally, external validation should connect to post-deployment governance via drift detection, performance triggers, and change-control plans, complemented by site-specific local evaluation to ensure safety and reliability across diverse clinical environments. When executed to these standards, external validation transforms promising prototypes into dependable clinical tools, clarifying where a model performs, where it fails, and what adaptations are necessary for safe, equitable, and sustainable use. This framework links statistical evaluation to clinical use, model updating, and post-deployment monitoring.
zh_abstract: [European heart journal] 外部验证是指在来自其他中心、人群、时间段或设备的独立数据上测试冻结的人工智能模型。当这些外部数据能够代表预期人群、测量过程和临床工作流程的实际部署情况时，外部验证可对预期使用场景下的性能提供最清晰的估计。它能给出对区分度和校准度的真实估计，揭示捷径学习和分布偏移，通过决策分析指标量化临床效用，并揭示需要缓解的亚组差异。然而，一些常见陷阱会损害其可信度：带有隐性相关性的准外部划分；疾病谱和患病率不匹配；中心、工作流程和硬件效应；标签噪声和参考标准漂移；分析灵活性和选择性报告；样本量小、统计效能不足；仅依赖曲线下面积；未报告的阈值调整；以及数据泄漏。一份实用蓝图强调：预注册；涵盖地域、时间和采集方式的有代表性的多中心队列；防止患者和时间上的重叠；全面评估区分度、校准度（包括整体校准、校准斜率和校准图）以及带置信区间的净获益；预先设定的亚组和公平性审计；透明的标注流程和不确定性分析；有原则的样本量计算；以及最小化且有完善记录的模型更新（先重新校准再修订）。最后，外部验证应通过漂移检测、性能触发条件和变更控制计划与部署后治理相衔接，并辅以特定中心的本地评估，以确保在不同临床环境中的安全性和可靠性。按照这些标准执行时，外部验证可将有前景的原型转化为可靠的临床工具，阐明模型在何处表现良好、在何处失败，以及为实现安全、公平和可持续使用需要进行哪些调整。该框架将统计评估与临床使用、模型更新和部署后监测联系起来。

title: Sequence Scanning Improves Accuracy for Antibody-Antigen and Molecular Glue Ternary Complex Cofolding.
zh_title: 序列扫描提升抗体-抗原与分子胶三元复合物共折叠精度
summary: 提出序列扫描工作流，通过系统约束增加采样多样性，在 Boltz 和 Protenix 上提升抗体-抗原及分子胶三元复合物预测精度。
key_points: 在 Boltz 与 Protenix 上评估
针对抗体-抗原与分子胶两类难点
在大型多样基准集上精度提升
reason: 针对AlphaFold3类模型短板，基准评估充分，属值得一看档
abstract: [ChemMedChem] Accurately modeling biomolecular interactions is crucial for understanding biological function and can accelerate drug discovery efforts. Deep-learning-based cofolding methods such as AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2 can successfully predict many different biomolecular complexes. However, these models show lower success rates in predicting antibody-antigen and molecular glue (MG) ternary complexes, two cases of high relevance to pharmaceutical research. Here, we present sequence scanning, a new workflow, evaluated on Boltz and Protenix, that improves prediction accuracy in these domains by applying systematic constraints to enhance overall sampling diversity. For both use cases, we assess the performance of the method on large, diverse benchmark sets. We find improved accuracy of the sequence scanning workflow in predicting antibody-antigen interface contacts and in pose prediction quality for MGs compared to previously published results. We also discuss remaining challenges and potential improvements to the method.

abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] Accurate diagnosis of middle ear diseases remains challenging due to the specialized nature of otoscopic interpretation and the global shortage of otolaryngologists. We aimed to evaluate the impact of a deep learning-based AI support system on the diagnostic performance of clinicians with varying levels of expertise, specifically focusing on its ability to bridge the gap between trainees and experts. In this retrospective reader study, a deep learning model (EfficientNet-B4) was developed using a large-scale dataset of 7335 endoscopic images. The model was designed for multi-class classification, simultaneously identifying primary categories (chronic otitis media, otitis media with effusion, or none [indicating the absence of the first two]) and secondary features (attic retraction, myringitis, otomycosis, and ventilation tube). To assess clinical impact, diagnostic performance was compared among 3 otology professors, 5 senior residents, and 5 junior residents using an independent clinical assessment set of 100 images. Participants performed diagnoses both with and without AI-generated predictions, with a time constraint of 1 minute per image to simulate real-world clinical pressure. In 5-fold cross-validation, the deep learning model achieved 94.8% accuracy for the primary classification. The stand-alone AI achieved diagnostic accuracies ranging from 94.0% to 99.0% in the clinical assessment set. AI support significantly enhanced diagnostic accuracy across all groups for primary classification, with improvements of 11.0% for otology professors, 28.8% for senior residents, and 32.2% for junior residents (P<.001). Accuracy increased from 78.7% to 89.7% for otology professors, from 65.0% to 93.8% for senior residents, and from 54.4% to 86.6% for junior residents. The accuracy gap between the most experienced (otology professors) and least experienced (junior residents) groups was reduced from 24.3% to 3.1%. For secondary categories, significant improvements were observed in diagnosing attic retraction and myringitis among residents. AI-supported accuracy for attic retraction was higher in senior residents than that of the stand-alone AI, although the 95% CIs overlapped substantially, so the difference was not statistically significant. Our findings demonstrate that deep learning-based AI support substantially improves the diagnostic accuracy of middle ear diseases, particularly for less experienced clinicians. title: scRM: A single-cell foundation model trained on scRNA-seq reads

summary: scRM自称首个以测序读段而非计数矩阵预训练的单细胞基础模型，称其以较低算力成本具有竞争力，代码已开源。
key_points: 以原始测序读段进行预训练

reason: 新颖的单细胞基础模型预印本，开源；细节有限，命中基础模型偏好
abstract: To our knowledge, scRM is the first single-cell foundation model trained on sequencing reads, demonstrating that raw data pretraining is not only feasible but competitive at a fraction of the computational cost. We anticipate that scaling this framework and exploring alternative architectures will unlock biological information inaccessible to count models and extend the dataset-specific pretraining it already makes possible. title: A single-cell multimodal foundation model enables cross modality analysis between transcriptome and chromatin
zh_title: MUTUAL：连接转录组与染色质的单细胞多模态基础模型
summary: MUTUAL冻结scFoundation与EpiAgent，在300万配对细胞、400个多组学数据集上学习共享RNA-ATAC空间，并在10个未参与训练的数据集上无需重训应用。
key_points: 基于300万配对细胞、400个公开multiome数据集
在10个外部数据集上跨模态匹配优于同数据集拟合的方法
可将转录因子motif活性迁移至仅RNA细胞
reason: 有新意的基础模型预印本，含留出数据集验证，但为预印本，命中基础模型偏好
abstract: Most single-cell studies measure either gene expression or chromatin accessibility, and connecting the two usually requires fitting a model to each study. Here we present MUTUAL (MUltiome Transfer in a Unified Aligned Latent space), which keeps the single-cell foundation models scFoundation and EpiAgent frozen, combines their embeddings with linear summaries of each modality and learns a shared RNA--ATAC space from 3.0 million paired cells of 400 public multiome datasets. Applied without refitting to ten datasets not used for training, MUTUAL matched cells' RNA and ATAC profiles more accurately than methods fitted on other donors of the same dataset, annotated ATAC-only cells more accurately and transferred transcription-factor motif activity to RNA-only cells beyond what cell-type assignment provides. In a maturation series of stem-cell-derived islets, motif activity predicted from RNA largely reproduced the measured stage-wise changes when other libraries of the series served as the reference. MUTUAL makes public multiome data directly usable by single-modality studies.
zh_abstract: 大多数单细胞研究仅测量基因表达或染色质可及性之一，而要将二者联系起来，通常需要针对每项研究分别拟合模型。在此，我们提出 MUTUAL（MUltiome Transfer in a Unified Aligned Latent space），该方法保持单细胞基础模型 scFoundation 和 EpiAgent 冻结，将二者的嵌入与各模态的线性摘要相结合，并从 400 个公开多组学（multiome）数据集的 300 万个配对细胞中学习共享的 RNA–ATAC 空间。在未重新拟合的情况下应用于十个未用于训练的数据集时，MUTUAL 在匹配细胞的 RNA 与 ATAC 谱方面比在同一数据集其他供体上拟合的方法更准确，对仅有 ATAC 的细胞的注释也更准确，并且能够将转录因子基序活性迁移至仅有 RNA 的细胞，其效果超出细胞类型归属本身所能提供的信息。在干细胞来源胰岛的成熟系列中，当以该系列的其他文库作为参照时，由 RNA 预测的基序活性在很大程度上重现了所测得的各阶段变化。MUTUAL 使公开的多组学数据可直接用于单模态研究。

title: Preceding organ trajectories guide dynamic reassessment after apparent stabilisation in sepsis
zh_title: 既往器官轨迹指导脓毒症表面稳定后的动态再评估
summary: 预印本在四个ICU数据库19,690名成人中评估，加入既往器官轨迹可提升低严重度器官恶化的预警捕获，并在升压药亚组改善预后区分。
key_points: eICU 2,492次提醒中捕获由219增至282
去甲肾上腺素组AUROC由0.5925升至0.6929
reason: 多库大样本含外部评估，但为预印本，AUROC提升有限
abstract: Apparent organ recovery can conceal residual vulnerability in sepsis. Across 19,690 adults in four intensive care databases, we evaluated six-hour deterioration in low-severity organs after transition to single-organ dysfunction. At 2,492 eICU reassessment alerts, adding preceding organ trajectories increased capture from 219 to 282 episodes (28.8%; difference 63, 95% CI 38.0 to 93.5). Reassessment depended on the availability and updating of that history. Withholding half of record batches lost 108.3 captures; adaptation recovered approximately one third, and targeted retrieval increased timely correct nominations from 151 to 163. New measurements modified the value of earlier history, while local calibration and alert scheduling improved external reassessment. Among 813 norepinephrine-treated patients, history improved hypotension-or-death discrimination (AUROC 0.5925 to 0.6929) and, in the fixed-model comparison, concentrated larger estimated recorded exposure reductions across treatment priorities (AUTOC difference 25.68 micrograms/kg, 95% CI 5.23 to 46.16). These findings support retaining organ trajectories for dynamic reassessment and treatment prioritisation.
zh_abstract: 在脓毒症中，表面上的器官恢复可能掩盖残余的脆弱性。我们在四个重症监护数据库的 19,690 名成人中，评估了转为单器官功能障碍后低严重程度器官的 6 小时恶化情况。在 2,492 次 eICU 再评估警报中，加入先前的器官轨迹使捕获的事件数从 219 增至 282（28.8%；差值 63，95% CI 38.0 至 93.5）。再评估取决于该历史信息的可获得性和更新。隐去一半的记录批次会损失 108.3 次捕获；适应性调整可恢复约三分之一，而定向检索使及时且正确的提名从 151 增至 163。新的测量改变了早期历史的价值，而本地校准和警报调度改善了外部再评估。在 813 名接受去甲肾上腺素治疗的患者中，历史信息改善了对低血压或死亡的区分能力（AUROC 从 0.5925 升至 0.6929），并且在固定模型比较中，使不同治疗优先级上估计的记录暴露量降幅更大且更集中（AUTOC 差值 25.68 微克/千克，95% CI 5.23 至 46.16）。这些发现支持保留器官轨迹，用于动态再评估和治疗优先级排序。

title: Physiological Trajectories and Observation Patterns in ICU Mortality Prediction: Transportability Under Changing Measurement Conditions
zh_title: ICU死亡率预测中的生理轨迹与观测模式：测量条件变化下的可迁移性
summary: 用MIMIC-III/IV与eICU比较生理轨迹和观测模式在ICU 48小时死亡预测中的外部可迁移性，并控制观测数量评估测量时间影响。
key_points: MetaVision 7762例训练，外部测试MIMIC-IV与eICU
eICU覆盖204家医院共43878例
生理轨迹提升外部预测
reason: 大样本外部验证，但为回顾性预印本，增益较小
abstract: Objective: To distinguish the transferable predictive value of physiological trajectories from that of observation patterns in ICU mortality prediction, and to assess whether measurement timing affects performance independently of observation quantity. Materials and Methods: In-hospital mortality was predicted at 48 hours using MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, and eICU. Nested representations progressively integrated latest-value snapshots (R1), longitudinal physiological summaries (R2), and measurement frequency and timing features (R3). Models fitted on 7,762 MetaVision patients were evaluated on 21,682 MIMIC-IV patients and 43,878 eICU patients across 204 hospitals. The effect of measurement timing was assessed while holding the number of retained observations constant. Results: Physiological trajectories improved external prediction in eICU (R2-R1 log-loss difference -0.00922, 95% CI -0.01148 to -0.00704). Observation-pattern features improved locally developed eICU models (R3-R2 -0.00257, 95% CI -0.00370 to -0.00146), but not clearly after transfer from MetaVision (-0.00012, 95% CI -0.00206 to +0.00208). R3 was favoured in 10 of 30 source bootstrap refits. At matched observation counts, retaining measurements spread throughout the window reduced log loss relative to random retention by 0.03280 for R3 versus 0.00703 for R2. Removing the final 12 hours increased log loss relative to count-matched random removal by 0.01947 for R3 versus 0.00822 for R2. Under reduced availability, the local R3 increment changed from beneficial to harmful. Discussion: Physiological trajectories transferred more consistently, while observation-pattern features were particularly sensitive to the timing and availability of measurements. Conclusion: Clinical prediction models should be evaluated not only in new patient populations but also under the measurement conditions that supply their inputs.
zh_abstract: 【目的】区分生理轨迹与观测模式在ICU死亡率预测中的可迁移预测价值，并评估测量时机是否独立于观测数量而影响模型性能。【材料与方法】使用MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV和eICU，在48小时时预测院内死亡率。嵌套式表征逐步整合最新值快照（R1）、纵向生理汇总（R2）以及测量频率和时机特征（R3）。在7,762例MetaVision患者上拟合的模型，在21,682例MIMIC-IV患者和来自204家医院的43,878例eICU患者中进行评估。在保持保留观测数量不变的情况下评估测量时机的影响。【结果】生理轨迹改善了eICU中的外部预测（R2-R1对数损失差值 -0.00922，95% CI -0.01148至-0.00704）。观测模式特征改善了在eICU本地开发的模型（R3-R2 -0.00257，95% CI -0.00370至-0.00146），但从MetaVision迁移后改善不明确（-0.00012，95% CI -0.00206至+0.00208）。在30次源数据bootstrap重拟合中，R3在10次中占优。在观测数量匹配的情况下，与随机保留相比，保留分布于整个时间窗内的测量使R3的对数损失降低0.03280，而R2为0.00703。与数量匹配的随机移除相比，移除最后12小时使R3的对数损失增加0.01947，而R2为0.00822。在可用性降低的情况下，本地R3增量由有益变为有害。【讨论】生理轨迹的迁移更为一致，而观测模式特征对测量的时机和可用性尤为敏感。【结论】临床预测模型不仅应在新的患者人群中评估，还应在提供其输入数据的测量条件下进行评估。

title: GazeRIB: Systematic Evaluation of Multi-Reader Gaze-Guided Chest X-ray Learning
zh_title: GazeRIB：多读者视线引导胸片学习的系统评估
summary: 评估8位专家对80张胸片的视线，用于遮蔽未注视区域训练；在2,897张胸片队列上测试910个模型，各读者组合均使宏F1提升5.33-7.47个百分点。
key_points: 七种架构、10个随机种子共910个模型
所有读者组合均优于无视线基线
三位读者即获得八人组73-80%的增益
reason: 预印本，实验系统、对照充分并含人机协作，但仅独立队列且仅预印本
abstract: Radiologists' visual attention can supervise medical image learning, but how reader panel composition affects its value remains untested. We evaluated GazeRIB (Gaze-guided Radiologist-Informed Blackout), which masks unviewed regions during training and uses unmasked images at inference. Eight experts repeatedly read the same 80 chest X-rays (CXRs). We compared individual readers with three-, five- and eight-reader panels across seven architectures and 10 seeds, evaluating 910 models on a separate 2,897-CXR cohort for four-class severity prediction. Every panel improved macro F1 over the no-gaze baseline by 5.33-7.47 percentage points (pp; Bonferroni-adjusted p < 0.007); no individual reader reached significance on this endpoint. Three readers captured 73-80% of the eight-reader gain in macro F1, the area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) and the area under the precision-recall curve (AU-PRC). On external validation without retraining, all four panels improved ROC-AUC on SIIM-FISABIO-RSNA by +1.93 to +4.24 pp (p <= 0.004); on MIMIC-Eye no panel differed significantly from baseline, whereas the single-reader average declined (-1.40 pp, p = 0.008). Reader composition therefore influenced performance, although transfer depended on the cohort.
zh_abstract: 放射科医生的视觉注意力可用于监督医学图像学习，但阅片者小组的构成如何影响其价值尚未得到检验。我们评估了 GazeRIB（Gaze-guided Radiologist-Informed Blackout，注视引导的放射科医生知情遮蔽），该方法在训练时遮蔽未被观察的区域，在推理时使用未遮蔽的图像。八位专家对同样的 80 张胸部 X 线片（CXR）进行了重复阅片。我们在七种架构和 10 个随机种子下，比较了单个阅片者与三人、五人和八人小组，共评估 910 个模型，在一个独立的 2,897 张 CXR 队列上进行四分类严重程度预测。每个小组的宏平均 F1 均较无注视基线提高 5.33-7.47 个百分点（pp；Bonferroni 校正 p < 0.007）；在该终点上，没有任何单个阅片者达到显著性。三名阅片者获得了八人小组在宏平均 F1、受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC-AUC）和精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AU-PRC）方面增益的 73-80%。在不重新训练的外部验证中，四个小组在 SIIM-FISABIO-RSNA 上的 ROC-AUC 均提高了 +1.93 至 +4.24 pp（p <= 0.004）；在 MIMIC-Eye 上，没有任何小组与基线存在显著差异，而单个阅片者的平均值则下降（-1.40 pp，p = 0.008）。因此，阅片者构成影响了性能，但迁移效果取决于队列。

title: From WSIs to Bulk, Spatial and Single-Cell Transcriptomics via Multi-Scale Graph Neural Networks
zh_title: 多尺度图神经网络从WSI预测bulk、空间与单细胞转录组
summary: 用病理基础模型UNI2-h提取特征，构建patch与细胞级图，从WSI同时预测bulk、空间和单细胞转录组。
key_points: 基于UNI2-h特征构建多尺度空间图
整合TCGA、Visium、Xenium数据训练
涉及肺、肾、乳腺组织
reason: 病理基础模型新方法，命中偏好；证据有限
abstract: Understanding the spatial distribution of gene expression is key to studying complex diseases like cancer. While Spatial Transcriptomics (ST) and Single-Cell Transcriptomics (scT) provide high-resolution insights, they remain expensive and scarce. In contrast, standard histopathology Whole-Slide Images (WSIs) paired with bulk RNA sequencing are widely available. This work introduces a Multi-Scale Graph Neural Network (GNN) capable of simultaneously predicting bulk, spatial, and single-cell transcriptomics directly from WSIs. By extracting morphological features using a Pathology Foundation Model (PFM) (UNI2-h) and constructing spatial graphs at both patch and cell levels, the model learns the hierarchical relationships within the tissue. The network is trained on a combined dataset of The Cancer Genome Atlas Program (TCGA), Visium, and Xenium samples across lung, kidney, and breast tissues. A hybrid training strategy is employed, leveraging direct supervision alongside weakly supervised consistency losses to ensure predictions align across biological scales. Results show the model accurately predicts gene expression at the slide level and moderately at the patch level (strongest on Xenium), and achieves moderate correlation at the challenging single-cell level. Furthermore, downstream tasks explore the clinical relevance of these predictions, demonstrating their utility in survival analysis, spatial hazard mapping, and tumor classification via molecular signatures.
zh_abstract: 了解基因表达的空间分布是研究癌症等复杂疾病的关键。尽管空间转录组学（Spatial Transcriptomics，ST）和单细胞转录组学（Single-Cell Transcriptomics，scT）能够提供高分辨率的信息，但二者仍然昂贵且稀缺。相比之下，标准组织病理学全切片图像（Whole-Slide Images，WSIs）及其配对的bulk RNA测序数据则广泛可得。本研究提出一种多尺度图神经网络（Multi-Scale Graph Neural Network，GNN），能够直接从WSIs同时预测bulk、空间和单细胞转录组。该模型利用病理基础模型（Pathology Foundation Model，PFM）（UNI2-h）提取形态学特征，并在图像块（patch）和细胞两个层面构建空间图，从而学习组织内部的层级关系。网络在由癌症基因组图谱计划（The Cancer Genome Atlas Program，TCGA）、Visium和Xenium样本组成的联合数据集上进行训练，涵盖肺、肾和乳腺组织。研究采用混合训练策略，在直接监督的基础上结合弱监督一致性损失，以确保不同生物学尺度上的预测相互一致。结果显示，该模型在整张切片水平上可准确预测基因表达，在图像块水平上表现中等（在Xenium上最强），并在具有挑战性的单细胞水平上达到中等相关性。此外，下游任务探讨了这些预测的临床相关性，证明其在生存分析、空间风险图绘制以及基于分子特征的肿瘤分类中具有实用价值。

title: RECITE: Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence
zh_title: RECITE：基于文本证据修订入排标准的框架
summary: 利用 ClinicalTrials.gov 方案修订文档构建11,913条数据集，并在多种LLM配置上基准测试入排标准的自动修订。
key_points: 覆盖5,735项试验的11,913个实例
测试15种LLM配置，含截断与检索增强
以LLM评审并经10位领域专家校验
reason: 试验设计相关新数据集与基准，预印本，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Overly restrictive eligibility criteria contribute to widespread enrollment failure in clinical trials, yet published recommendations for how specific criteria should be broadened remain disconnected from trial design at scale. We introduce RECITE (Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence), a framework for automated discovery, extraction, and implementation of evidence-based eligibility criteria revisions. RECITE uses protocol amendment documents from ClinicalTrials.gov to construct a dataset of 11,913 curated instances across 5,735 trials, each pairing original criteria with documentary evidence and target revisions. We benchmark fifteen LLM configurations under truncated-to-context-window and retrieval-augmented generation conditions, on a 3,116-instance sample under an LLM-as-judge protocol validated against ten domain experts (judge vs. human quadratic-weighted Cohen's $κ_{qw} = 0.694 \pm 0.096$). The best open-weight model, Gemma 2 9B, achieves $κ_{qw}$-aligned ordinal score $3.0 \pm 0.9$ on a 0--4 scale (normalized 0.742) and the best closed-weight model, GPT-4o, reaches $3.0 \pm 0.8$ (normalized 0.745). Using an agentic literature discovery system, we then identified 44 paper--trial matches across five publications providing trial-design and EC-modification evidence. Our findings suggest that existing clinical knowledge can be operationalized into actionable trial design recommendations.
zh_abstract: 过于严格的入选标准导致临床试验中普遍出现入组失败，然而已发表的关于应如何放宽具体标准的建议与大规模试验设计之间仍然脱节。我们提出了RECITE（Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence，结合文本证据修订入选标准），这是一个用于自动发现、提取和实施基于证据的入选标准修订的框架。RECITE利用ClinicalTrials.gov中的方案修正文件，构建了一个包含5,735项试验、共11,913个经过整理的实例的数据集，每个实例将原始标准与文献证据及目标修订相配对。我们在截断至上下文窗口和检索增强生成两种条件下，对15种大语言模型（LLM）配置进行了基准测试，使用3,116个实例的样本，并采用经10位领域专家验证的LLM作为评判者的方案（评判者与人类的二次加权Cohen's κ，$κ_{qw} = 0.694 \pm 0.096$）。表现最佳的开放权重模型Gemma 2 9B在0–4分的量表上取得与$κ_{qw}$对齐的有序评分$3.0 \pm 0.9$（归一化0.742），表现最佳的闭源权重模型GPT-4o达到$3.0 \pm 0.8$（归一化0.745）。随后，我们利用一个智能体式文献发现系统，在提供试验设计和入选标准修改证据的五篇出版物中识别出44个论文—试验匹配。我们的研究结果表明，现有临床知识可以转化为可操作的试验设计建议。

title: With foundation-model features, aggregator complexity does not improve cross-hospital discrimination in gastric whole-slide image classification
zh_title: 基础模型特征下，聚合器复杂度不提升胃癌WSI跨院判别

key_points: 5,036张胃H&E切片，5家医院
留一医院验证，冻结病理基础模型特征
CHIME-MIL平均AUC 0.837，但不优于简单池化

abstract: Whole-slide image classifiers are usually developed within one hospital and often go untested at unseen hospitals. We assembled 5,036 haematoxylin-and-eosin-stained gastric slides from five Korean hospitals, scanned at 20x and 40x, and compared multiple-instance learning aggregators under leave-one-hospital-out validation on frozen pathology foundation-model features. A hierarchical patch-region-slide graph aggregator (CHIME-MIL) with site alignment and two-scale fusion reached a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.837, above six conventional attention and transformer aggregators trained without these steps. Under a matched recipe it did not exceed attention-based pooling, and global max pooling given the same alignment and fusion was better (AUC 0.855, P = 0.0002). The alignment, which subtracts each hospital's mean feature vector without labels, onboarded a new hospital from ten unlabelled slides and cost 0.002 AUC without held-out-hospital data, but its accuracy gains were small and inconsistent. The model had low top-label calibration error (0.053) but under-confident malignancy probabilities, and removing its most-attended patches lowered the malignancy probability far more than removing random patches. With these features, more complex aggregators did not improve discrimination; what a deployable system adds is label-free onboarding, calibration checks and auditable evidence.
zh_abstract: 全切片图像分类器通常在单一医院内开发，往往未在未见过的医院中进行测试。我们收集了来自韩国五家医院的5,036张苏木精-伊红染色胃部切片，以20倍和40倍扫描，并在冻结的病理基础模型特征上，采用留一医院验证法比较了多种多示例学习聚合器。一种带有站点对齐和双尺度融合的分层图块-区域-切片图聚合器（CHIME-MIL）达到平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）0.837，高于六种未采用这些步骤训练的传统注意力和Transformer聚合器。在匹配的训练方案下，它并未超过基于注意力的池化，而在采用相同对齐和融合的情况下，全局最大池化表现更好（AUC 0.855，P = 0.0002）。该对齐方法通过无需标签地减去各医院的平均特征向量，仅用十张无标签切片即可接入新医院，在没有留出医院数据的情况下AUC损失为0.002，但其准确率提升很小且不一致。该模型的最高置信标签校准误差较低（0.053），但恶性概率偏低（置信不足），并且去除其最受关注的图块所导致的恶性概率下降远大于去除随机图块。就这些特征而言，更复杂的聚合器并未改善判别能力；可部署系统所增加的是无标签接入、校准检查和可审计的证据。

title: Patient attitudes toward artificial intelligence-driven dermatology.
source: PubMed · The Journal of investigative dermatology
zh_title: 患者对AI驱动皮肤科的态度：系统叙述性综述
summary: 遵循PRISMA的系统叙述性综述，纳入20项研究，梳理患者或公众对皮肤科AI诊断及相关流程的态度，结果显示信任有条件。

abstract: [The Journal of investigative dermatology] Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly being developed for dermatology, but the conditions under which patients trust these tools remain poorly characterized. This Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses-guided systematic narrative review synthesizes peer-reviewed empirical studies, published from January 1, 2015 through July 7, 2026, that directly assessed patient or public attitudes toward AI in dermatologic diagnosis, skin-cancer screening, image sharing, teledermatology image-quality support, and related patient-facing workflows. Eligible evidence included qualitative interviews and focus groups, surveys, preference/conjoint or vignette experiments, and early clinical deployments. Twenty studies met the inclusion criteria using the review framework. Across study designs, patients expressed conditional support for dermatology AI but consistently favored dermatologist-supervised AI over autonomous AI, especially for high-stakes diagnostic decisions. Trust was strengthened by visible clinician accountability, clear explanations of AI outputs and uncertainty, privacy safeguards, transparent data use, and evidence that performance is reliable across skin tone and diagnosis. Trust declined when AI was framed as replacing clinicians, when image governance was unclear, or when unequal performance was perceived. These findings support a model of augmented intelligence: dermatology AI should serve the clinical relationship; be subject to human oversight; and be evaluated and reported stratified by skin tone, diagnosis, and care context.
zh_abstract: [The Journal of investigative dermatology] 皮肤科人工智能（AI）系统的开发日益增多，但患者在何种条件下信任这些工具仍缺乏清晰刻画。本系统性叙述综述遵循《系统评价和荟萃分析优先报告条目》（PRISMA）指引，综合了2015年1月1日至2026年7月7日期间发表的同行评审实证研究，这些研究直接评估了患者或公众对AI在皮肤科诊断、皮肤癌筛查、图像共享、远程皮肤科图像质量支持以及相关面向患者的工作流程中的态度。纳入的证据包括定性访谈和焦点小组、问卷调查、偏好/联合分析或情景实验，以及早期临床应用。按照综述框架，共有20项研究符合纳入标准。在各类研究设计中，患者对皮肤科AI表示有条件的支持，但始终更倾向于由皮肤科医生监督的AI，而非自主运行的AI，尤其是在高风险的诊断决策方面。可见的临床医生问责、对AI输出及不确定性的清晰解释、隐私保护措施、透明的数据使用，以及表明其性能在不同肤色和诊断间可靠的证据，会增强信任。当AI被描述为取代临床医生、图像管理不明确或被认为存在性能不均等时，信任则下降。这些发现支持一种增强智能（augmented intelligence）模式：皮肤科AI应服务于临床关系；接受人工监督；并应按肤色、诊断和诊疗情境分层进行评估与报告。

abstract: [Age and ageing] Polypharmacy is common in people living with dementia (PLwD) and associated with adverse outcomes. Although Structured Medication Reviews (SMRs) are recommended to optimise medication regimens, their delivery is often constrained by limited resources. Artificial intelligence (AI) may support SMRs, yet little is known about how it is perceived by PLwD and their carers. This study explored their experiences of polypharmacy, views on SMRs and attitudes towards use of AI tools in SMRs. Semi-structured interviews with 12 PLwD experiencing polypharmacy and two focus groups with 14 carers were conducted via Microsoft Teams or telephone and analysed using Reflexive Thematic Analysis. Two themes were constructed: participants' perspectives on meaningful SMRs, and embracing AI while preserving patient safety and the human touch. Participants described challenges in managing polypharmacy, with carers playing a central role in supporting adherence and monitoring side effects. Experiences of SMRs varied. SMRs were most valued when clinicians were empathetic and able to offer personalised guidance. Participants viewed AI use in SMRs positively, provided that such tools were well validated and used to assist rather than replace healthcare professionals. AI was also seen as potentially reducing administrative burden and supporting more person-centred care. However, some had concerns regarding patient safety and data security, highlighting the need for appropriate regulation and human oversight. Participants were supportive of AI use in SMRs, despite concerns about safety, data security and disclosure of AI use, and emphasised the importance of patient-clinician interactions and lived experience involvement in AI tool development.
zh_abstract: [Age and ageing] 多重用药在痴呆症患者（PLwD）中很常见，并与不良结局相关。尽管推荐通过结构化用药回顾（SMR）来优化用药方案，但其实施往往受限于资源不足。人工智能（AI）可能有助于 SMR，但 PLwD 及其照护者如何看待这一问题尚知之甚少。本研究探讨了他们的多重用药经历、对 SMR 的看法以及对在 SMR 中使用 AI 工具的态度。通过 Microsoft Teams 或电话，对 12 名存在多重用药的 PLwD 进行了半结构化访谈，并与 14 名照护者开展了两次焦点小组讨论，采用反思性主题分析法进行分析。归纳出两个主题：参与者对有意义的 SMR 的看法，以及在保障患者安全和人文关怀的同时接纳 AI。参与者描述了管理多重用药所面临的挑战，其中照护者在支持服药依从性和监测副作用方面发挥核心作用。参与者的 SMR 体验各不相同。当临床医生富有同理心并能提供个性化指导时，SMR 最受重视。参与者对在 SMR 中使用 AI 持积极态度，前提是这类工具经过充分验证，并且用于辅助而非取代医疗专业人员。AI 也被认为可能减轻行政负担并支持更以人为本的照护。然而，一些人对患者安全和数据安全表示担忧，凸显了适当监管和人工监督的必要性。尽管对安全性、数据安全以及是否披露使用 AI 存在顾虑，参与者仍支持在 SMR 中使用 AI，并强调医患互动以及在 AI 工具开发中纳入亲身经历者参与的重要性。

abstract: [Journal of health care for the poor and underserved] Health-related social needs such as housing instability, food insecurity, and transportation barriers are associated with worse health outcomes and increased health care utilization, particularly among older adults. Although health systems increasingly screen for these needs, many lack the capacity to provide follow-up support at scale. This pilot evaluation described the implementation and early operational performance of an artificial intelligence-supported, on-demand patient navigation service integrated into an urban safety-net health system. From July 2024 to March 2025, providers placed 149 referrals from family medicine and geriatrics clinics. Outreach was attempted for all referred patients, and successful contact occurred for 78 patients. Navigators submitted 301 applications for public benefits and community resources; 145 were approved, while others remained pending or in process at analysis. Program costs during the observation period were approximately $5,000. These findings suggest feasibility while highlighting the need for further evaluation of patient experience and outcomes.
zh_abstract: [Journal of health care for the poor and underserved] 住房不稳定、食物不安全和交通障碍等与健康相关的社会需求，与较差的健康结局和更高的医疗服务利用相关，尤其是在老年人中。尽管卫生系统越来越多地筛查这些需求，但许多系统缺乏大规模提供后续支持的能力。本试点评估描述了一项由人工智能支持的按需患者导航服务在城市安全网卫生系统中整合实施的情况及早期运行表现。2024 年 7 月至 2025 年 3 月，家庭医学和老年医学门诊的医务人员共提交了 149 份转介。对所有被转介患者均尝试了联系，其中 78 例患者成功联系。导航员提交了 301 份公共福利和社区资源申请；145 份获批，其余在分析时仍处于待定或办理中。观察期内项目成本约为 5,000 美元。这些发现提示该服务具有可行性，同时也强调需要对患者体验和结局作进一步评估。

abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Topologically associating domains (TADs) are fundamental units of 3D chromatin organization, and accurate identification of TAD boundaries from Hi-C contact matrices remains an active challenge. Recent deep learning approaches have advanced substantially, but these rely on increasingly large architectures, raising the question of how much of this capacity boundary-centric analysis requires. Here we propose AxialTAD, a compact deep learning model centered on an Axial Contrast Module (ACM) that explicitly encodes directional contrast in contact intensity along the row and column axes of local Hi-C patches, an operator aligned with the geometric signature of TAD boundaries. Evaluated on four human cell lines (GM12878, HeLa-S3, IMR-90, K562) within cell lines and under leave-one-cell-out generalization, AxialTAD performed comparably with a recent convolutional neural network (CNN)+Transformer baseline (deepTAD) while using 76%-80% fewer trainable parameters (113K-137K versus 571K). A parameter-matched conventional CNN achieved similar F1 to AxialTAD in the human 25 kb experiments. When trained and evaluated within each of two mouse datasets, AxialTAD outperformed both this control and deepTAD. Orthogonal validation against CTCF and cohesin ChIP-seq supported the biological plausibility of the predicted boundaries. These results indicate that, within the range of architectures examined, a large architecture is not necessary to reach this level of boundary prediction.

abstract: [Expert review of medical devices] Quality Control (QC) and Quality Assurance (QA) are central to safety, effectiveness, and regulatory compliance of medical devices. The transition from 21 CFR 820 to the Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR) formalizes harmonization with ISO 13485. Artificial intelligence (AI) is being explored in clinical and manufacturing settings and may support medical-device quality and compliance when appropriately validated. This review examines AI applications within QC, QA, and regulatory systems across the product lifecycle. Health-care examples are included only when they illustrate quality, validation, human oversight, or lifecycle-management considerations relevant to medical devices. Clinical and manufacturing applications are discussed in the context of FDA Computer Software Assurance and quality frameworks. A narrative literature search used PubMed, Google Scholar, FDA.gov, EUR-Lex, and IMDRF.org and covered publications from January 2010 through September 2025. AI can shift medical device QC and QA from reactive approaches toward predictive, risk-based paradigms. When integrated within a robust QMS, AI can improve process capability, reduce human variability, and enable earlier detection of quality and compliance risks. Adoption should be guided by regulatory science, clear intended use, lifecycle validation, effective change control, transparency, and sustained human oversight to protect patient safety and maintain regulatory compliance.

abstract: [Family medicine] We are in a time of rapid adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in medical care and medical education. We sought to determine the patterns of use and training in AI among family medicine (FM) residents. The 2025 American Board of Family Medicine (ABFM) National Resident Survey (NRS) was administered in October 2025 to all FM residents who completed the In-Training Exam. Residents were asked about their use of AI in the last month and any education about AI use they received in the last 6 months. Resident demographics were obtained from ABFM administrative databases. A total of 15,259 residents completed the AI questions (response rate: 99.6%) with 10,858 residents (71.1%) reporting they used AI in the last month. The most common uses reported were for medical reference (40.7%), clinical decision support (31.9%), learning outside of patient care (23.6%), and ambient documentation of clinical encounters (21.9%). Only 36% reported any AI education or training in the last 6 months. Most FM residents reported recent use of AI tools, reflecting integration of these technologies into routine educational and clinical activities. However, formal training on AI use appears limited, suggesting a gap between adoption and structured competency development. The widespread use of AI by family medicine trainees has risks and opportunities for our future primary care workforce that will require new critical appraisal skills and new methods for teaching and assessing clinical reasoning.

abstract: [Ophthalmic epidemiology] The purpose of this study is to investigate the potential of large language models (LLMs), including ChatGPT and Google Gemini, to improve health literacy in ophthalmology. By analyzing their ability to provide personalized responses to health-related inquiries, this research aims to assess the effectiveness of these AI tools in addressing ophthalmic conditions. This narrative review analyzed 31 studies evaluating the performance of publicly available LLMs in patient education across various ophthalmic topics. Key parameters assessed included accuracy, accessibility, and adaptability to diverse populations. LLMs produced accurate responses on eye health, simplifying medical information and adapting the readability and language of its outputs. Challenges included occasional misinformation, misunderstood contexts, and Western-centric biases. LLM performance improved when specific strategies were used, such as prompt engineering and revisions of patient education materials by ophthalmologists. LLMs' accessibility harbours the potential to improve ophthalmic health literacy. To maximize their utility, collaborative development with patients and ophthalmologists, legislative oversight, and continuous updates on ophthalmic data are essential.

abstract: [Physical therapy] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into health care delivery, but its influence on consumer perceptions of physical therapist services remains unclear. The objective was to examine how the use of AI influences consumer perceptions of in-person and telerehabilitation physical therapist services. This study used a randomized 2 × 2 factorial experimental design comparing AI use and delivery mode. The experiment was conducted online in Australia. The study included 710 Australian adults recruited through a paid panel. Participants were randomized to 1 of 4 hypothetical physical therapist consultation scenarios (in-person vs telerehabilitation; AI used vs not used). Perceived warmth; competence; safety; provider trust; emotional trust; relational and functional service quality; working alliance; and intention to use were measured on 7-point Likert-scales. Composite mean scores were analyzed using ordinary least squares regression with heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors. Mean scores in the no-AI, in-person condition ranged from 4.8 to 5.8. Among in-person scenarios, described AI use was associated with lower ratings across all outcomes, including warmth (b = -0.3, 95% CI = -0.5 to -0.1), competence (-0.4, -0.6 to -0.2) and safety (-0.8, -1.1 to -0.6), provider trust (-0.5, -0.7 to -0.3) and intention to use (-0.8, -1.0 to -0.5). Without AI, telerehabilitation also reduced ratings by 0.2 to 0.7 points across outcomes. Positive interaction effects indicated attenuation of AI-related reductions in telerehabilitation for relational (interaction b = 0.4, 95% CI = 0.1 to 0.8) and functional service quality (0.36, 0.02 to 0.70), intention to use (0.6, 0.1 to 1.0), and perceived safety (0.5, 0.1 to 0.9). Hypothetical in-person consultations described as involving AI were associated with poorer consumer perceptions of physical therapists and services. Telerehabilitation was also perceived less favorably than in-person care. Future studies should test whether transparency and reassurance mitigate the effects of AI-use on consumer perceptions of physical therapy.

abstract: [Journal of the American Heart Association] Percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) remains the cornerstone of revascularization in coronary artery disease. However, despite advances in stent technology, adverse outcomes related to suboptimal stent placement including under-expansion, malapposition, incomplete coverage, edge dissection, and neoatherosclerosis persist. Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is the highest resolution widely available intravascular imaging modality, allowing unparalleled visualization of stent-vessel interactions and plaque morphology. However, there are significant barriers to large-scale OCT adoption, including time-consuming manual interpretation and dependence on the operator, resulting in significant variability between analysts. Artificial intelligence (AI)-based automated OCT analysis promises to assist PCI by delivering rapid, reproducible, and standardized stent optimization, but current analysis systems lack important features to optimize stent placement. This review summarizes the principles of OCT in PCI, the evidence for OCT-guided optimization, and recent advances in AI-driven automated OCT analysis. We discuss plaque analysis and classification, highlighting how AI-driven automated OCT analysis can identify fibrous, lipid-rich, and calcified lesions and guide tailored lesion preparation using balloons, specialty balloons, drug-coated balloons, intravascular lithotripsy, and atherectomy. We outline emerging AI-enabled workflows for fully automated PCI optimization, evaluate clinical outcomes, interpretability, and workflow integration. Finally, we explore future directions including AI imaging-physiology fusion, multiomics integration, and robotics. If successful, automated AI-empowered OCT analysis could become a central imaging platform for precision PCI, enabling tailored lesion preparation, optimal stent deployment, and improved clinical outcomes in coronary artery disease management.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Heart Association] 经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）仍然是冠状动脉疾病血运重建的基石。然而，尽管支架技术不断进步，与支架置入欠佳相关的不良结局，包括支架扩张不全、贴壁不良、覆盖不完全、边缘夹层和新生动脉粥样硬化，依然存在。光学相干断层成像（OCT）是目前广泛可用的分辨率最高的血管内成像方式，能够以无与伦比的清晰度显示支架与血管的相互作用和斑块形态。然而，OCT 大规模应用存在显著障碍，包括人工判读耗时、依赖操作者，导致分析者之间存在明显差异。基于人工智能（AI）的 OCT 自动分析有望通过提供快速、可重复且标准化的支架优化来辅助 PCI，但现有分析系统缺乏优化支架置入所需的重要功能。本综述总结了 OCT 在 PCI 中的原理、OCT 指导优化的证据，以及 AI 驱动的 OCT 自动分析的最新进展。我们讨论了斑块分析与分类，强调 AI 驱动的 OCT 自动分析如何识别纤维性、富含脂质和钙化病变，并指导使用球囊、特殊球囊、药物涂层球囊、血管内碎石术和旋磨术进行个体化病变预处理。我们概述了用于全自动 PCI 优化的新兴 AI 工作流程，并评估了临床结局、可解释性和工作流程整合。最后，我们探讨了未来方向，包括 AI 影像-生理融合、多组学整合和机器人技术。如果成功，AI 赋能的 OCT 自动分析有望成为精准 PCI 的核心影像平台，实现个体化病变预处理、最佳支架置入，并改善冠状动脉疾病管理中的临床结局。

abstract: Background. Testing and deploying medical AI systems at scale already results in more outputs than clinicians can review, and the use of large language models (LLMs) as judges is growing rapidly. Decision-only models, cheap and fast models that return structured probabilities rather than text, offer a potentially scalable option for that goal. Methods. In an OSF pre-registered evaluation, we tested TypeSafe Jev 1.13 as a judge on tasks from five validated clinical benchmarks: rubric grading (HealthBench), planted clinical errors (When Rubrics Fail), risk in AI-written clinical documents (MedVAL), counseling ratings and failures (CounselBench) and physicians' preferences between answers (Real-POCQi). Comparators were expert raters' agreement with each other, OpenAI Decisions, GPT-6 Luna, a proposed hybrid team combining decision models and a cheap LLM and, as frontier comparators, GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5. The main outcome was plain agreement with the expert label. Results. The test comprised 25,091 units and 213,913 model calls. Jev's agreement with expert labels averaged 64.7% over six tasks. On 3,614 matched units it averaged 66.1%, against 65.0% for Opus and 60.7% for Sol, and it was non-inferior to both on four of six tasks. Jev judged the whole pool in 17 minutes for US$1.46; per judgment, it cost 1/34 of Sol's price and 1/152 of Opus's. A preset cutoff held its false-alarm rate on fresh planted-error answers, and in simulation, reviewing Jev's least-sure answers first found 1.4 times the errors of a random audit. Still, omissions were hard for both: at the same false-alarm rate, Jev missed 55.6% of planted omissions and Opus 48.1%, and Opus caught 8.8 points more planted errors overall. Conclusions. Across more than 200,000 model calls, a decision-only model was non-inferior to two frontier judges on most tasks at a small fraction of their cost and time, while reporting how sure it was of every call. With local cutoffs and expert oversight of omissions and clinical documents, judging every output of a deployed medical AI system becomes more affordable.
