【背景】大规模测试和部署医疗人工智能系统已经产生了超出临床医生审阅能力的输出量，而将大语言模型（LLM）用作评判者的做法正在迅速增长。仅决策模型（decision-only models）是一类廉价、快速、返回结构化概率而非文本的模型，为实现这一目标提供了一种潜在可扩展的选择。
【方法】在一项于OSF预注册的评估中，我们在来自五个经验证的临床基准的任务上测试了TypeSafe Jev 1.13作为评判者的表现：量表评分（HealthBench）、植入的临床错误（When Rubrics Fail）、AI撰写临床文档中的风险（MedVAL）、咨询评分与失误（CounselBench），以及医生对不同回答的偏好（Real-POCQi）。比较对象包括专家评分者之间的一致性、OpenAI Decisions、GPT-6 Luna、一种将决策模型与廉价LLM相结合的拟议混合团队，以及作为前沿比较对象的GPT-6.1 Sol和Claude Opus 5.5。主要结局为与专家标签的单纯一致率。
【结果】本次测试包含25,091个单元和213,913次模型调用。Jev与专家标签的一致率在六项任务上平均为64.7%。在3,614个匹配单元上，其平均一致率为66.1%，Opus为65.0%，Sol为60.7%；在六项任务中的四项上，Jev相对于两者均不劣效。Jev仅用17分钟、1.46美元即完成了整个样本池的评判；按每次判断计算，其成本为Sol的1/34、Opus的1/152。预设的截断值在新的植入错误答案上保持了其误报率；在模拟中，优先审阅Jev最不确定的答案所发现的错误数为随机审核的1.4倍。然而，遗漏错误对两者都很困难：在相同误报率下，Jev漏检了55.6%的植入遗漏，Opus漏检48.1%，且Opus总体上多发现了8.8个百分点的植入错误。
【结论】在超过200,000次模型调用中，一个仅决策模型在大多数任务上相对于两个前沿评判模型不劣效，而成本和时间仅为其一小部分，同时还能报告其对每次判断的把握程度。借助本地截断值，并由专家对遗漏错误和临床文档进行监督，对已部署医疗AI系统的每一项输出进行评判将变得更加经济可行。

title: Triage Advice From General-Purpose Language Models in Health and Everyday Situations
zh_title: 通用语言模型在健康与日常情境中的分诊建议
summary: 横断面研究评估53个通用模型配置对82条情景消息的4346条回复，比较健康与非健康情境下建议就医的情况。
key_points: 53个模型配置、82条研究者撰写消息
比较健康与非健康情境的专业转诊
以人工评定的必要接触级别为参照
reason: 模型覆盖广的预印本评测，无真实患者
abstract: Importance: One adult in 10 has consulted a chatbot for health information within 6 months, and nearly half of users do so to decide whether they need care. Referral regardless of need could add demand on stretched services. Objective: To compare referral to a professional by general-purpose language models in health and non-health situations against the level of contact that human raters judged necessary. Design, Setting, and Participants: Cross-sectional study of 4,346 responses generated in September 2026 by 53 general-purpose model configurations, released between March 2023 and September 2026 and accessed through APIs or run locally, to 82 investigator-written messages (41 health and 41 non-health). No patients were involved. Exposures: Health vs non-health scenario. Main Outcomes and Measures: Professional referral, unconditional or conditional on a future change or on doubt, coded by 3 language models and compared with the level of contact that physicians, pharmacists and 2 technically trained raters judged necessary. Results: Referral occurred in 74.7% of health and 46.3% of non-health responses, more often for health in every configuration (standardized difference, 28.3 percentage points; 95% CI, 18.3-37.0). Where raters judged contact unnecessary, 64.5% of health vs 27.6% of non-health responses recommended a professional (odds ratio, 17.08; 95% CI, 6.14-47.54); most of the health excess was conditional referral (46.3% vs 21.0%), and unconditional referral was 18.1% vs 6.6% (odds ratio, 4.66; 95% CI, 1.43-15.19). Where an in-person assessment was judged necessary, referral was similar (89.6% vs 84.5%). In medicines and physical health, referral was not associated with rated severity (odds ratio per point, 1.16; 95% CI, 0.53-2.55), unlike outside health (3.86; 95% CI, 1.79-8.33). The referral gap was 20.5 percentage points among configurations released in 2023 and 32.2 and 32.3 in 2025 and 2026 (4.8 percentage points per year; 95% CI, 2.3-7.2). Conclusions and Relevance: General-purpose language models referred people to a professional where a visit was needed, in health as outside it, but in health also in 2 in 3 situations that physicians and pharmacists judged manageable without contact, a pattern stronger in newer models. Evaluations of these systems should include whether their advice distinguishes situations that can be deferred or managed at a distance, alongside the referral of serious cases.
zh_abstract: 【重要性】成年人中每10人就有1人在6个月内曾向聊天机器人咨询健康信息，近半数用户借此判断是否需要就医。无论是否需要都建议转诊，可能会给本已紧张的医疗服务增加需求。【目的】比较通用语言模型在健康与非健康情境中向专业人员转诊的情况，并与人类评分者判断所需的接触水平进行对照。【设计、setting 与参与者】横断面研究，共4,346条回复，由53种通用语言模型配置于2026年9月生成；这些模型发布于2023年3月至2026年9月之间，通过API访问或本地运行；回复针对82条由研究者撰写的消息（41条健康类，41条非健康类）。未涉及患者。【暴露】健康情境与非健康情境。【主要结局与指标】向专业人员转诊（无条件转诊，或以未来变化或存疑为条件的转诊），由3个语言模型编码，并与医师、药师及2名受过技术培训的评分者判断所需的接触水平比较。【结果】健康类回复中74.7%出现转诊，非健康类回复中为46.3%；每种配置中健康类转诊均更多（标准化差异28.3个百分点；95% CI，18.3-37.0）。在评分者判断无需接触的情形中，64.5%的健康类回复与27.6%的非健康类回复推荐了专业人员（比值比17.08；95% CI，6.14-47.54）；健康类的超出部分大多为条件性转诊（46.3% vs 21.0%），无条件转诊为18.1% vs 6.6%（比值比4.66；95% CI，1.43-15.19）。在判断需要面对面评估的情形中，转诊率相近（89.6% vs 84.5%）。在药物和躯体健康方面，转诊与评分严重程度无关（每增加1分的比值比1.16；95% CI，0.53-2.55），而在健康领域之外则相关（3.86；95% CI，1.79-8.33）。转诊差距在2023年发布的配置中为20.5个百分点，在2025年和2026年发布的配置中分别为32.2和32.3个百分点（每年4.8个百分点；95% CI，2.3-7.2）。【结论与意义】通用语言模型在需要就诊的情形下会建议转诊，健康领域与非健康领域皆然；但在健康领域，即使在医师和药师判断无需接触即可处理的情形中，也有约三分之二推荐了专业人员，且这一模式在较新的模型中更为明显。对这些系统的评估，除严重病例的转诊外，还应包括其建议能否区分可延后处理或可远程处理的情形。

title: Identifying interstitial lung disease with large language models on clinical notes and claims
zh_title: 用大语言模型基于临床笔记和理赔数据识别间质性肺病
summary: 在309例肿瘤患者中，对12个开源LLM与20种已发表的理赔算法比较识别间质性肺病的表现，LLM无需任务特定训练。
key_points: MGB 309例ILD编码患者，由两位肺科医生裁定
输入为理赔、EHR笔记或两者结合
评估PPV与yield，并推演对药物性ILD比值比的偏倚影响
reason: 预印本，单机构样本中等，有多模型与算法对比，未见外部验证
abstract: Interstitial lung disease (ILD) is a potentially fatal toxicity of immune checkpoint inhibitors and antibody-drug conjugates. Drug-safety studies in healthcare databases identify ILD with claims-based algorithms that trade positive predictive value (PPV) against sensitivity. We assessed whether large language models (LLMs) improve on these algorithms, with and without electronic health record (EHR) notes, and whether these gains translate into measurable epidemiological benefits. In 309 oncology patients with ILD diagnosis codes at Mass General Brigham, adjudicated by two pulmonologists, we compared 12 open-access LLMs with 20 published claims-based algorithms. LLMs received claims, EHR notes, or both, without task-specific training. Measures were PPV and yield (proportion classified positive). We projected the attenuation of a drug-induced ILD odds ratio under non-differential outcome misclassification. LLMs extended the PPV-yield frontier of the published algorithms with all three inputs. Across the 36 model--input evaluations, LLM PPV exceeded that of the best algorithm without specialist-coding requirements (Algorithm 4) by 14.3 percentage points on average. With claims alone, Qwen3-8B achieved 89.8% PPV (95% CI 78.2-95.6) at 15.9% yield, versus 86.7% at 4.9% for the highest-PPV algorithm. With notes alone, Qwen3-32B achieved 78.9% PPV at 49.2% yield, versus 64.6% at 51.1% for Algorithm~4. With combined claims and notes, Qwen3-14B achieved 100.0% PPV at 24.3% yield. Under a simulated drug-safety scenario with a true odds ratio of 3.0, the projected observed odds ratio was 2.67 with combined inputs versus 1.07 with Algorithm 4, corresponding to a 46-fold difference in the estimated sample size required for 80% power (591 versus 27,200 patients). Zero-shot LLMs offer a higher-PPV alternative to rule-based claims phenotyping for ILD, on all three input types. Because the claims-only configuration uses the same claims data as existing algorithms, it could be deployed in administrative databases without linked notes, and may recover drug-safety signal otherwise lost to outcome misclassification.
zh_abstract: 间质性肺病（ILD）是免疫检查点抑制剂和抗体-药物偶联物可能致命的毒性反应。医疗数据库中的药物安全性研究通过基于医保理赔数据的算法来识别ILD，这些算法需要在阳性预测值（PPV）与灵敏度之间进行权衡。我们评估了大语言模型（LLM）在有或无电子健康记录（EHR）病历笔记的情况下是否能优于这些算法，以及这些提升是否能转化为可测量的流行病学获益。在 Mass General Brigham 的 309 例有ILD诊断编码的肿瘤患者中（由两名肺科医生裁定），我们将 12 个开放获取的 LLM 与 20 种已发表的基于理赔数据的算法进行了比较。LLM 接收理赔数据、EHR 笔记或两者，且未经任务特异性训练。评价指标为 PPV 和检出率（yield，被分类为阳性的比例）。我们在非差异性结局错误分类的条件下，预测了药物性ILD比值比的衰减程度。在三种输入方式下，LLM 均拓展了已发表算法的 PPV-检出率前沿。在 36 个模型-输入组合评估中，LLM 的 PPV 平均比无需专科编码要求的最佳算法（算法 4）高 14.3 个百分点。仅使用理赔数据时，Qwen3-8B 的 PPV 为 89.8%（95% CI 78.2-95.6），检出率为 15.9%；而 PPV 最高的算法为 86.7%，检出率为 4.9%。仅使用笔记时，Qwen3-32B 的 PPV 为 78.9%，检出率为 49.2%；算法 4 为 64.6%，检出率为 51.1%。理赔数据与笔记联合使用时，Qwen3-14B 的 PPV 为 100.0%，检出率为 24.3%。在真实比值比为 3.0 的模拟药物安全性情景下，联合输入时预测的观察比值比为 2.67，而算法 4 为 1.07，相应地，达到 80% 检验效能所需估算样本量相差 46 倍（591 例对 27,200 例）。零样本 LLM 在全部三种输入类型下，均为基于规则的理赔数据ILD表型识别提供了 PPV 更高的替代方案。由于仅理赔数据的配置使用的数据与现有算法相同，因此可部署于没有关联笔记的行政数据库中，并可能挽回因结局错误分类而丢失的药物安全性信号。

title: Same answer, different reasons: AI-moderated interviews uncover topics and reasoning that surveys miss.
zh_title: 答案相同、理由不同：AI主持访谈可发现问卷遗漏的主题
summary: 预印本通过预注册随机设计，让1953名美国成人完成AI主持访谈和问卷，评估AI访谈能否大规模捕获问卷遗漏的推理过程。
key_points: 1953名成人，概率样本与自愿样本面板
参与者认可94%的提取主题
21–51%的访谈主题在封闭题中无对应
reason: AI社会科学方法，预注册随机设计、样本较大，但为预印本
abstract: Surveys can reach large samples but capture only pre-defined answers, with identical responses often concealing very different reasoning. We tested whether AI-moderated interviews capture this reasoning at scale. In a pre-registered, randomized, counterbalanced design, 1,953 US adults from a probability-based panel and an opt-in panel completed three AI-moderated interviews as well as a section with closed-ended and open-text survey items. Topics were extracted from transcripts inductively, without a predefined codebook, and validated by a confirmatory follow-up. Participants endorsed 94% of topics as fair descriptions of what they said. 21-51% of topics from the AI interview had no counterpart in the closed-ended battery, and 17-37 percentage points net coverage over open text answers. Among respondents who gave identical closed-ended responses, their reasoning diverged widely in valence and content. AI-moderated interviews surface reasons that closed-ended and open-text items miss, and show how reasoning differs among people who answer alike.
zh_abstract: 问卷调查可以覆盖大样本，但只能获取预先设定的答案，而相同的回答往往掩盖了截然不同的推理过程。我们检验了 AI 主持的访谈能否大规模捕捉这种推理。在一项预先注册、随机、平衡对照的设计中，来自概率抽样面板和自愿加入面板的 1,953 名美国成年人完成了三次 AI 主持的访谈，以及一个包含封闭式和开放文本问卷题目的部分。主题由访谈记录归纳提取，未使用预先设定的编码手册，并通过验证性随访加以确认。参与者认可 94% 的主题能够公允地描述他们所说的内容。AI 访谈得出的主题中有 21–51% 在封闭式题组中没有对应项，相对于开放文本回答的净覆盖率高出 17–37 个百分点。在封闭式回答完全相同的受访者中，其推理在倾向和内容上差异很大。AI 主持的访谈能够揭示封闭式和开放文本题目所遗漏的原因，并显示回答相同的人之间推理有何不同。

title: AI integration for transforming care of patients with liver diseases.
zh_title: AI融入肝病诊疗：应用综述
summary: 该综述概述了AI在肝病学中的现有应用，指出传统评分系统在纤维化评估和结局预测中存在局限。
key_points: 慢性肝病约占全球死亡的4%
传统评分依赖离散实验室指标，可能漏诊并存在亚组偏倚
基于PubMed检索对AI在肝病中的应用进行综述
reason: 综述类，泛泛概述，上限6分内偏低
abstract: [Hepatology international] Chronic liver disease is a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide, accounting for approximately 4% of global deaths. Despite the increasingly complex care of liver disease, conventional scoring systems remain widely used to assess fibrosis and predict clinical outcomes. Although cost-effective and interpretable, these scores have limitations that may contribute to missed diagnoses and delayed treatment. Furthermore, their reliance on discrete laboratory biomarkers may inadequately reflect patients' overall clinical status and may introduce bias across demographic subgroups. This review aims to provide an overview of current applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in hepatology. A literature search of PubMed was conducted to identify publications addressing the application of AI in liver disease. The literature was reviewed to examine the use of AI in diagnosis, risk stratification, clinical prioritization, and liver transplantation, as well as its application across liver diseases of different etiologies. Technical challenges and barriers to clinical implementation were also considered. Artificial intelligence models can integrate multimodal data and capture complex, nonlinear relationships, potentially enabling a more comprehensive assessment of patients' physiological status and disease progression than conventional scoring systems. AI has considerable potential to enhance diagnostic accuracy, prognostic assessment, risk stratification, and decision-making in liver transplantation. However, limitations relating to model interpretability, generalizability, data quality, algorithmic bias, and integration into clinical workflows must be addressed to facilitate safe, equitable, and effective implementation in hepatology.
zh_abstract: [《国际肝病学》] 慢性肝病是全球发病和死亡的主要原因，约占全球死亡的4%。尽管肝病的诊疗日益复杂，传统评分系统仍被广泛用于评估纤维化和预测临床结局。这些评分虽然成本效益高且易于解释，但存在局限性，可能导致漏诊和治疗延误。此外，它们依赖离散的实验室生物标志物，可能无法充分反映患者的整体临床状况，并可能在不同人口学亚组中引入偏倚。本综述旨在概述人工智能（AI）在肝病学中的当前应用。我们对PubMed进行了文献检索，以识别涉及AI在肝病中应用的出版物。我们回顾了文献，以考察AI在诊断、风险分层、临床优先排序和肝移植中的应用，以及其在不同病因肝病中的应用。同时也讨论了技术挑战和临床实施的障碍。人工智能模型可整合多模态数据并捕捉复杂的非线性关系，与传统评分系统相比，可能更全面地评估患者的生理状态和疾病进展。AI在提高诊断准确性、预后评估、风险分层和肝移植决策方面具有相当大的潜力。然而，必须解决模型可解释性、可推广性、数据质量、算法偏倚以及融入临床工作流程等方面的局限，才能促进其在肝病学中安全、公平且有效的实施。

title: CT-Based Pulmonary Segment Delineation: An Imaging Informatics Review of Methods, Benchmarks, Robustness, and Clinical Deployment.
source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
zh_title: 基于CT的肺段划分：方法、基准、鲁棒性与临床部署综述
summary: 综述CT肺段划分方法，涵盖传统多阶段流程与CNN、GNN、隐式神经表示等深度学习框架，并讨论基准、鲁棒性与临床部署。
key_points: 肺段划分用于肺段切除规划与定量分析
强调气道与血管树等支气管血管先验
涵盖CNN、GNN、隐式神经表示、GMM建模
reason: 专科影像方法综述，按规则上限6，内容较常规
abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Accurate bronchopulmonary segment delineation on computed tomography (CT) is essential for segmentectomy planning, computer-assisted thoracic interventions, and fine-grained quantitative lung analysis. However, segment-level parenchymal partitioning remains technically challenging because intersegmental boundaries are often subtle or indistinct on routine CT, requiring bronchovascular priors-particularly airway and vascular trees-to guide anatomically plausible delineation. This review presents an imaging informatics-based synthesis of CT-based pulmonary segment delineation, covering conventional multi-stage pipelines and recent deep learning frameworks, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), graph neural networks (GNNs), implicit neural representations, and continuous spatial modeling parameterized by Gaussian mixture models (GMMs). We organize evaluation practices into three complementary categories: direct ground-truth-based metrics, indirect anatomy-referenced criteria, and reference-free plausibility or quality-control measures. We further review publicly available datasets, annotation protocols, and benchmark limitations that currently hinder reproducible and fair segment-level comparison. From a deployment perspective, we discuss clinical workflow requirements, robustness challenges, and the need for anatomy-aware and data-efficient methods. Illustrative analyses of a single cystic fibrosis (CF) case using a distance-based method show how removal of a segmental airway branch or omission of lobar constraints can substantially alter the resulting segment territories. These case-specific observations motivate broader robustness evaluation, uncertainty-aware quality control, boundary-level plausibility checks, and deployment-oriented validation beyond conventional overlap-based metrics.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 在计算机断层扫描（CT）上准确勾画支气管肺段对于肺段切除术规划、计算机辅助胸部介入以及精细的定量肺分析至关重要。然而，肺段水平的实质分割在技术上仍具挑战，因为在常规 CT 上肺段间边界往往细微或不清晰，需要借助支气管血管先验信息（尤其是气道和血管树）来引导符合解剖学的勾画。本综述从影像信息学角度综合论述基于 CT 的肺段勾画，涵盖传统多阶段流程和近期的深度学习框架，包括卷积神经网络（CNN）、图神经网络（GNN）、隐式神经表示，以及由高斯混合模型（GMM）参数化的连续空间建模。我们将评估方法归为三个互补的类别：基于直接真值的指标、基于解剖参照的间接标准，以及无参照的合理性或质量控制度量。我们还回顾了公开可用的数据集、标注规范，以及目前妨碍肺段水平可重复且公平比较的基准局限。从部署角度，我们讨论了临床工作流程要求、稳健性挑战，以及对解剖感知和数据高效方法的需求。针对单个囊性纤维化（CF）病例、采用基于距离的方法所做的示例分析显示，移除一个肺段气道分支或省略肺叶约束，可显著改变所得的肺段区域。这些针对个案的观察结果提示，需要开展更广泛的稳健性评估、具有不确定性感知的质量控制、边界层面的合理性检查，以及超越传统重叠度指标的面向部署的验证。

title: Machine Learning in the Differential Diagnosis of Bipolar and Borderline Personality Disorders: A Scoping Review.
source: PubMed · Canadian journal of psychiatry. Revue canadienne de psychiatrie
zh_title: 机器学习鉴别双相障碍与边缘型人格障碍：范围综述
summary: 范围综述检索多个数据库，纳入机器学习及相关预测方法用于区分双相障碍与边缘型人格障碍的研究，24篇进入全文评估。
key_points: 检索Ovid MEDLINE、PsycInfo、Embase等库
共2594条记录，24篇全文评估
聚焦BD与BPD的鉴别诊断
reason: 精神健康方向范围综述，纳入研究少，综述上限内偏低
abstract: [Canadian journal of psychiatry. Revue canadienne de psychiatrie] BackgroundBipolar disorder (BD) and borderline personality disorder (BPD) are associated with substantial morbidity and can be difficult to distinguish when symptoms are assessed cross-sectionally. This scoping review examines machine learning (ML) and related predictive approaches designed to differentiate the two conditions.MethodsWe searched Ovid MEDLINE, APA PsycInfo, Embase, Web of Science, Scopus, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, and selected computer science conference proceedings through July 2, 2026. Full-text peer-reviewed journal articles and conference papers were eligible when they used a data-driven computational or statistical prediction approach to distinguish, classify, or characterize BD and BPD. Of 2,594 records identified, 2,523 unique records were screened, and 24 full texts were assessed. Screening followed the Population, Concept, Context framework, Joanna Briggs Institute guidance, and preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analyses extension for scoping reviews.ResultsNine reports met the inclusion criteria. Seven participant-based reports contributed an aggregate of 986 report-level participants, although two reports used overlapping cohorts; one conference paper used synthetic data, and one study analyzed 149,798 Reddit posts. Studies including clinical samples reported BD versus BPD discrimination AUC (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve) values of 0.67 to 0.91 and accuracies ranging from 61.7% to 90%. These estimates were not directly comparable and were derived from small, often imbalanced samples using heterogeneous internal validation. No model was externally validated in an independent clinical cohort.ConclusionThe evidence remains preliminary and does not support clinical deployment. Reported performance is constrained by small samples, class imbalance, uncertain ground-truth labels, spectrum bias, and reliance on pre-existing diagnoses. Prospective studies in consecutive at-risk cohorts, with transparent reporting and independent external validation, are required.
zh_abstract:
[Canadian journal of psychiatry. Revue canadienne de psychiatrie]【背景】双相情感障碍（BD）和边缘型人格障碍（BPD）均与较高的疾病负担相关，在横断面评估症状时可能难以区分。本范围综述考察了旨在区分这两种疾病的机器学习（ML）及相关预测方法。
【方法】我们检索了 Ovid MEDLINE、APA PsycInfo、Embase、Web of Science、Scopus、IEEE Xplore、ACM Digital Library 以及部分计算机科学会议论文集，检索截至2026年7月2日。凡采用数据驱动的计算或统计预测方法来区分、分类或刻画BD与BPD的同行评审期刊全文论文和会议论文均符合纳入条件。在检索到的2,594条记录中，对2,523条不重复记录进行了筛选，并评估了24篇全文。筛选遵循“人群、概念、情境”（Population, Concept, Context）框架、Joanna Briggs 研究所指南以及系统综述和荟萃分析优先报告条目的范围综述扩展版。
【结果】9篇报告符合纳入标准。7篇基于参与者的报告合计包含986名报告层面的参与者，但其中两篇报告使用了重叠的队列；一篇会议论文使用合成数据，一项研究分析了149,798条Reddit帖子。纳入临床样本的研究报告的BD与BPD区分AUC（受试者工作特征曲线下面积）值为0.67至0.91，准确率为61.7%至90%。这些估计值不具有直接可比性，且来自样本量小、往往不均衡的数据，并采用了不同的内部验证方法。没有任何模型在独立临床队列中进行过外部验证。
【结论】现有证据仍属初步，不支持临床应用。所报告的性能受到样本量小、类别不平衡、真实标签不确定、谱偏倚以及依赖既有诊断的限制。需要在连续入组的高危队列中开展前瞻性研究，并做到报告透明和独立的外部验证。

title: Same Question, Different Answers: Auditing Persona-Dependent Variation in Six LLMs on Smoking-Cessation Advice
zh_title: 六个LLM戒烟建议的用户画像依赖性差异审计
summary: 预印本用12种用户画像向6个LLM提出戒烟问题（共2,880条回答），发现回答随提问者画像而变化，对青少年画像提及处方戒烟药物更少。
key_points: 6个LLM、4家厂商、12种画像、4个问题
对青少年提及FDA批准处方药少32至67个百分点
5/6模型对自称医护者提供的事实更少
reason: 预印本，审计规模适中，公平性发现有信息量，无临床结局
abstract: Hundreds of millions of people now ask large language model (LLM) chatbots for health advice, which raises a question that is simple to pose and hard to answer: does everyone get the same advice? We audit six widely deployed LLMs from four providers on smoking cessation, a domain with codified clini- cal guidance and substantial public-health stakes, by putting the same four cessation questions to twelve user personas that differ in life stage, self-described expertise, and smoking history, for a total of 2,880 responses. What the models say depends on who appears to be asking. Every model named FDA-approved prescription cessation medications less often to teen personas than to adult personas, by 32 to 67 percentage points, and in five of six models a persona presenting health- care expertise received fewer facts than a persona presenting none. We then evaluate one deployable intervention: a short system prompt specifying a factual floor, the set of core med- ical facts every user should receive when they are relevant, while leaving tone, vocabulary, and framing free to adapt. The prompt narrows persona differences in every model, but its effect on overall fact coverage varies in both magnitude and direction across models, so a prompt validated on one system cannot be assumed to transfer to another. Two cautions frame these results. Equal mention rates are not always the correct clinical target, because prescription cessation pharmacother- apy is not recommended for minors, so a defensible factual floor must be age-aware rather than uniform. And because our personas vary on several attributes at once, we report scenario- level differences rather than isolated effects of age or expertise. We release all 2,880 responses and the analysis code.

title: TopoHyperClinicalGraph: A Geometry and Topology-Aware Multimodal Framework for Cancer Survival Prediction
zh_title: TopoHyperClinicalGraph：几何拓扑感知的癌症生存预测多模态框架
summary: 结合双曲组织几何、持久拓扑和临床图学习，基于UNI2-h特征，在8个TCGA/CPTAC队列2364例患者上做生存预测，C-index优于PatchGCN。
key_points: 双曲邻域加Lorentz质心注意力池化
持久性拓扑描述符与五节点临床图校正
八个队列五折评估，C-index小幅提升
reason: 病理预后新方法有基线对比，但为预印本、仅公开队列、提升小
abstract: We developed TopoHyperClinicalGraph, a multimodal framework combining hyperbolic tissue geometry, persistent topology and clinical graph learning for cancer survival prediction. Pre-extracted UNI2-h features are reduced from 1,536 to 1,024 dimensions using training-fold PCA. A pathology backbone combines hyperbolic neighborhoods with Lorentz-centroid attention pooling. Once frozen, its survival logits are adjusted using persistence descriptors from up to 64 landmarks per slide and sampling controls. A five-node clinical graph then learns a further correction from age, sex, stage, T and N. Five-fold patient-level evaluation covered eight TCGA and CPTAC cohorts with 2,364 patients. Mean validation-selected C-indices for TopoHyperClinicalGraph versus pathology-only spatial PatchGCN were 0.7563 versus 0.7386 in COADREAD, 0.6220 versus 0.5998 in HNSC, 0.6755 versus 0.6535 in BRCA and 0.6409 versus 0.6176 in STAD. CPTAC scores were 0.5984 in HNSC, 0.6060 in PDA, 0.8055 in CCRCC and 0.7192 in LUAD. CPTAC-HNSC used TCGA-initialized adaptation; other CPTAC backbones were trained within their cohorts. Geometry accounted for most pathology-only gains, with smaller persistence effects. Clinical graph fusion exceeded its matched node-wise control in five cohorts, tied in one and scored lower in two; clinical-only prediction exceeded fusion in three CPTAC cohorts. The framework supports separate evaluation of geometric, topological and clinical contributions. All scores were validation-selected; independent testing is needed to establish generalizability.
zh_abstract: 我们开发了TopoHyperClinicalGraph，这是一个结合双曲组织几何、持续拓扑和临床图学习的多模态框架，用于癌症生存预测。预提取的UNI2-h特征通过训练折内PCA由1,536维降至1,024维。病理骨干网络将双曲邻域与Lorentz质心注意力池化相结合。冻结后，其生存logits利用每张切片最多64个地标的持续性描述符及采样对照进行调整。随后，一个五节点临床图根据年龄、性别、分期、T和N学习进一步的校正。在八个TCGA和CPTAC队列共2,364例患者中进行了五折患者水平评估。TopoHyperClinicalGraph与仅病理的空间PatchGCN相比，验证选择的平均C指数分别为：COADREAD 0.7563 vs 0.7386，HNSC 0.6220 vs 0.5998，BRCA 0.6755 vs 0.6535，STAD 0.6409 vs 0.6176。CPTAC评分为：HNSC 0.5984，PDA 0.6060，CCRCC 0.8055，LUAD 0.7192。CPTAC-HNSC使用了TCGA初始化的适应；其他CPTAC骨干网络在各自队列内训练。仅病理的提升大部分来自几何，持续性效应较小。临床图融合在五个队列中优于其匹配的逐节点对照，一个队列持平，两个队列得分较低；在三个CPTAC队列中，仅临床预测优于融合。该框架支持对几何、拓扑和临床贡献分别评估。所有评分均为验证选择所得；需要独立测试以确定其泛化性。

title: Advancing Clinical Trial Outcome Prediction with Domain-Specific Large Language Models
zh_title: 领域专用语言模型用于临床试验结局预测
summary: 预印本在TOP基准（12,477项试验）上比较BioBERT与BioMistral的微调和探测方法，用于基于注册文本的分期结局预测。
key_points: 基于ClinicalTrials.gov十个字段构建文本
比较微调（全量/LoRA）与冻结探测
对照结构化方法HINT
reason: 预印本，有基线对比，基准公开，但证据有限
abstract: Clinical trial failures are a major barrier to efficient drug development, incurring substantial costs and delaying patient access to effective therapies. Structured approaches such as the Hierarchical Interaction Network (HINT) predict trial outcomes by explicitly modelling interactions between drugs, diseases and protocols, but make limited use of the free text in trial registrations. We evaluate two domain-specific language models, BioBERT (108M parameters) and BioMistral (7B parameters), for phase-level outcome prediction on the TOP benchmark (12,477 trials), representing each trial as text built from ten ClinicalTrials.gov fields. We compare fine-tuning (full fine-tuning for BioBERT, low-rank adaptation for BioMistral) with probing, in which the pretrained model is frozen and only a lightweight classifier is trained on its embeddings. On the held-out test set of each phase, all four language-model variants achieved higher ROC-AUC (0.613--0.772) and PR-AUC (0.649--0.901) than the published HINT results, corresponding to relative PR-AUC gains of 10--20\%. F1 differences were small and mixed, and no model, including HINT, clearly exceeded the F1 of a trivial classifier that predicts success for every trial. Under the configurations tested, probing performed comparably to fine-tuning: fine-tuned models scored highest on ROC-AUC and PR-AUC in Phases I and II, and frozen BioMistral embeddings in Phase III (ROC-AUC 0.772; PR-AUC 0.901), although most differences between variants were below 0.03 and were not tested for significance. These results suggest that pretrained biomedical representations already encode signal relevant to trial outcome, and that probing is a computationally cheaper alternative to fine-tuning for this task.
zh_abstract: 临床试验失败是高效药物研发的主要障碍，不仅造成巨额成本，还延误患者获得有效治疗。诸如分层交互网络（Hierarchical Interaction Network，HINT）等结构化方法通过显式建模药物、疾病与试验方案之间的相互作用来预测试验结果，但对试验注册中的自由文本利用有限。我们评估了两种领域特定语言模型 BioBERT（1.08亿参数）和 BioMistral（70亿参数）在 TOP 基准（12,477项试验）上进行分期（phase）层面试验结果预测的表现，将每项试验表示为由 ClinicalTrials.gov 十个字段构建的文本。我们比较了微调（BioBERT 采用全参数微调，BioMistral 采用低秩适配）与探测（probing，即冻结预训练模型，仅基于其嵌入训练一个轻量级分类器）。在各期的留出测试集上，四种语言模型变体的 ROC-AUC（0.613–0.772）和 PR-AUC（0.649–0.901）均高于已发表的 HINT 结果，PR-AUC 相对提升为 10–20%。F1 的差异较小且结果不一，包括 HINT 在内的任何模型均未明显超过对所有试验均预测为成功的简单分类器的 F1。在所测试的配置下，探测的表现与微调相当：微调模型在 I 期和 II 期的 ROC-AUC 和 PR-AUC 最高，而冻结的 BioMistral 嵌入在 III 期最高（ROC-AUC 0.772；PR-AUC 0.901），不过各变体之间的大多数差异小于 0.03，且未进行显著性检验。这些结果提示，预训练的生物医学表示已编码与试验结果相关的信号，且对该任务而言，探测是比微调计算成本更低的替代方案。

title: PsyInterviewee: Informational Invariance and Relational Adaptivity in Mental Health Interview Simulation
zh_title: PsyInterviewee：心理访谈模拟中的信息不变性与关系适应性
summary: 预印本提出PsyInterviewee，将受保护的事实通道与动态交互通道分离，并对照档案核验临床陈述，用于LLM模拟心理健康访谈对象。
key_points: 分离事实通道与交互通道
非对称写权限防止生成新临床事实
对照档案核验生成的临床陈述
reason: 预印本，心理健康LLM模拟有新意，证据有限
abstract: LLM-based simulated interviewees support interviewer training and the evaluation of mental health interviewing systems. Existing studies have primarily focused on improving human-likeness through richer patient profiles and behavioral modeling. However, human-likeness alone does not establish their reliability. Reliable simulation requires preserving profile-grounded clinical facts (informational invariance) while adapting disclosure and interaction behavior to the interview (relational adaptivity). To this end, we introduce PsyInterviewee, which separates a protected truth channel from a dynamic interaction channel and verifies generated clinical claims against the profile. Specifically, asymmetric write permissions allow dialogue context to update disclosure and behavioral states without authorizing new clinical facts; these states guide what profile-supported information is revealed and how it is expressed. In an automated evaluation of interactions between LLM-based interviewers and interviewees, PsyInterviewee achieves higher scores than four representative baselines on most metrics across both axes, as assessed by two LLM judges. Ablations suggest that the two channels contribute to clinical grounding and response modulation, respectively.
zh_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的模拟受访者可支持访谈者培训和心理健康访谈系统的评估。现有研究主要通过更丰富的患者档案和行为建模来提升拟人程度。然而，仅有拟人性并不能证明其可靠性。可靠的模拟需要保持基于档案的临床事实（信息不变性），同时使披露与互动行为适应访谈情境（关系适应性）。为此，我们提出 PsyInterviewee，它将受保护的真实信息通道与动态交互通道分离，并依据档案核验生成的临床陈述。具体而言，非对称的写入权限允许对话上下文更新披露状态和行为状态，但不能授权新增临床事实；这些状态指导披露哪些有档案支持的信息以及如何表达。在对基于 LLM 的访谈者与受访者之间互动的自动化评估中，经两个 LLM 评判者评估，PsyInterviewee 在两个维度的大多数指标上均高于四个代表性基线。消融实验提示，这两个通道分别有助于临床依据的保持和应答的调节。

title: Accurate and Auditable ECG Classification via Visibility Graph Neural Networks
zh_title: 基于可见图神经网络的可审计心电图分类
summary: LYNX-ECG将心拍表示为转折点可见图，在CODE-Test上宏F1为0.889，优于含ECGFounder的五个基线，并支持波形区域删除式审计。
key_points: 宏F1 0.889，优于五个基线
图存储量约为全样本图的14%
传导障碍中90%以上正确预测依据符合临床预期区域
reason: 预印本新方法有基线对比与可解释审计，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Physicians read electrocardiograms (ECGs) from waveform shape and timing, yet accurate deep-learning classifiers rarely show which waveform regions drive their predictions. We introduce LYNX-ECG, a graph neural network that represents each heartbeat as a sparse visibility graph of timestamped turning points. On CODE-Test, LYNX-ECG reaches a macro F1 score of 0.889, outperforming five baselines including the ECGFounder foundation model, while its graphs need about 14% of the storage of graphs built from every sample. Because each node maps to a specific ECG time, we can delete clinically defined waveform regions and alter beat timing to audit predictions. For conduction disorders, the clinically expected region was the strongest evidence in more than 90% of correct predictions. Bradycardia and tachycardia calls follow heart rate with conduction intervals held fixed, and atrial fibrillation calls vanish when beat-to-beat variation is removed. Sparse visibility graphs thus pair accurate ECG classification with clinically grounded, testable explanations.
zh_abstract: 医生通过波形的形态和时间来解读心电图（ECG），然而准确的深度学习分类器很少能显示是哪些波形区域驱动了其预测。我们提出了 LYNX-ECG，这是一种图神经网络，它将每个心搏表示为由带时间戳的转折点构成的稀疏可视图。在 CODE-Test 数据集上，LYNX-ECG 的宏平均 F1 分数达到 0.889，优于包括 ECGFounder 基础模型在内的五个基线模型，而其图所需的存储量约为由每个采样点构建的图的 14%。由于每个节点都对应一个特定的心电图时间，我们可以删除临床定义的波形区域并改变心搏时间，以审查预测结果。对于传导障碍，在超过 90% 的正确预测中，临床上预期的区域是最强的证据。在传导间期保持不变的情况下，心动过缓和心动过速的判定随心率而变化；当消除逐搏变异后，心房颤动的判定随之消失。因此，稀疏可视图将准确的心电图分类与有临床依据、可检验的解释结合在了一起。

title: VariaFlow: Uncertainty-Aware Flow Matching for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
zh_title: VariaFlow：面向无监督异常检测的不确定性感知流匹配
summary: VariaFlow在无条件流匹配先验下，用掩码引导的多次修复集成估计预测方差，以区分病变与健康解剖变异，改进脑部无监督异常检测。
key_points: 指出残差含病变与正常变异两类来源
集成多次修复估计各位置预测方差
基于流匹配先验的重建式检测
reason: 预印本有新意的方法，摘要未显示充分结果，属值得一看档
abstract: Reconstruction-based anomaly detection no longer fails at reconstruction. Generative models produce high-quality pseudo-healthy reconstructions, and the remaining difficulty is the step of scoring residuals. The residual between a scan and its reconstruction has two indistinguishable sources, genuine pathology and the anatomical variation that separates one healthy brain from another. Scoring against a single reconstruction treats both as anomalous, inflating false positives where healthy anatomy varies most while small or subtle lesions are lost in the surrounding reconstruction error. We identify the missing quantity as the predictive variance, how much a healthy reconstruction can vary at each location. We introduce VariaFlow, which estimates this variance from an ensemble of mask-guided restorations under an unconditional flow matching prior, each started from a different noise initialization, and which normalizes the residual by the resulting standard deviation. Few-step flow matching keeps the ensemble computationally affordable, and restoring at two spatial scales captures lesions of different size. Across three brain MRI datasets spanning stroke and tumor, VariaFlow is trained once on healthy anatomy and generalizes across all three, attaining the highest AUROC (0.94, 0.80, 0.78) on each and the highest AUPRC on both cross-domain datasets, exceeding the strongest baseline by 37% and 50%. Under domain shift, the same baseline drops by up to 52% in AUPRC, whereas VariaFlow stays more stable and achieves the best small-lesion Dice on all three datasets.
zh_abstract: 基于重建的异常检测在重建环节已不再是难题。生成模型能够产生高质量的伪健康重建图像，剩下的困难在于对残差进行评分。扫描图像与其重建图像之间的残差有两个无法区分的来源：真正的病理改变，以及使不同健康大脑彼此有别的解剖变异。仅依据单一重建结果进行评分会将二者都视为异常，导致在健康解剖变异最大的部位假阳性增多，而小的或细微的病灶则被淹没在周围的重建误差中。我们认为缺失的量是预测方差，即健康重建在每个位置可能的变化幅度。我们提出了 VariaFlow，它在无条件流匹配（flow matching）先验下，通过由掩码引导的多次修复所构成的集成来估计该方差，每次修复从不同的噪声初始化开始，并用所得标准差对残差进行归一化。少步数的流匹配使该集成的计算成本可以承受，并且在两个空间尺度上进行修复可捕获不同大小的病灶。在涵盖卒中和肿瘤的三个脑 MRI 数据集上，VariaFlow 仅在健康解剖数据上训练一次，即可泛化到全部三个数据集，在每个数据集上均取得最高的 AUROC（分别为 0.94、0.80、0.78），并在两个跨域数据集上取得最高的 AUPRC，分别比最强基线高出 37% 和 50%。在域偏移下，同一基线的 AUPRC 最多下降 52%，而 VariaFlow 更为稳定，并在全部三个数据集上取得最佳的小病灶 Dice。

title: Transferring Peptide-Target Interaction Patterns to Small Molecules by Joint Guidance for Diffusion and Flow Matching
zh_title: PIFT：联合引导扩散与流匹配，将肽-靶点作用模式迁移至小分子
summary: PIFT通过掩码离散扩散与连续流匹配的采样时联合引导，把肽-靶点界面作用模式迁移到小分子，用于靶向蛋白-蛋白相互作用。
key_points: 针对PPI浅而宽的结合界面
避免对肽结构的刚性原子级约束
离散扩散与流匹配联合引导
reason: 预印本新方法，药物发现方向，摘要未见实验证据，属值得一看档
abstract: Generating small molecules to target protein-protein interactions (PPIs) remains one of the most challenging yet high-reward frontiers in drug discovery. Unlike traditional small-molecule drugs that bind to deep, well-defined pockets, PPI interfaces often comprise broad, shallow binding surfaces. A natural strategy is to leverage known peptide-target interactions, as peptide ligands provide rich interface-level constraints. However, a major algorithmic challenge is that rigid atom-level conditioning on peptide structures can over-constrain the generative space and exclude valid small-molecule solutions. To address this challenge, we present PIFT (Peptide InterFace Transfer), a novel framework that transfers peptide-target interaction patterns to small molecules through joint sampling-time guidance of masked discrete diffusion and continuous flow matching. PIFT first maps peptide-target and small-molecule-target interfaces into a shared, target-conditioned interaction space, capturing transferable interface information across molecular modalities. The resulting peptide-derived reference then jointly steers building-block logits and 3D coordinates toward peptide-compatible molecules while preserving a strong adapted molecular prior. Extensive experiments across diverse PPI targets show that the learned representation captures cross-modal interaction compatibility, while peptide guidance improves interface recovery and achieves strong docking performance and favorable molecular properties.
zh_abstract: 生成靶向蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）的小分子，仍是药物研发中最具挑战性但回报也最高的前沿方向之一。与结合于深而明确口袋的传统小分子药物不同，PPI 界面通常由宽而浅的结合表面构成。一种自然的策略是利用已知的肽-靶标相互作用，因为肽配体可提供丰富的界面层面约束。然而，一个主要的算法挑战在于，对肽结构进行刚性的原子级条件约束可能会过度限制生成空间，并排除有效的小分子解。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 PIFT（Peptide InterFace Transfer，肽界面迁移），这是一种新颖的框架，通过对掩码离散扩散与连续流匹配进行联合的采样时引导，将肽-靶标相互作用模式迁移至小分子。PIFT 首先将肽-靶标界面和小分子-靶标界面映射到一个共享的、以靶标为条件的相互作用空间，从而捕获跨分子模态的可迁移界面信息。随后，由此得到的源自肽的参考信息共同引导构建模块的 logits 与三维坐标，使其朝向与肽相容的分子，同时保留经适配的强分子先验。在多种 PPI 靶标上开展的大量实验表明，所学习到的表示能够捕获跨模态相互作用相容性，而肽引导则改善了界面恢复，并取得了良好的对接表现和有利的分子性质。

title: ReuScope: Auditing Data Reuse and Evaluation Sensitivity in Capsule Vision 2024
zh_title: ReuScope：审计Capsule Vision 2024中的数据复用与评估敏感性
summary: 提出ReuScope审计协议，以Capsule Vision 2024为案例，发现训练与验证集存在字节级相同文件及共享源录像，去除相关训练数据后验证准确率明显下降。
key_points: 训练-验证集存在字节相同文件，41个Kvasir-Capsule录像两边均出现
十个种子下去除相关训练行，平衡准确率由82.5%降至61.2%
缺少跨录像患者标识，无法统计共享患者数
reason: 对公开基准数据泄漏的审计有价值，但为预印本且范围限于单一挑战赛
abstract: We develop ReuScope, a protocol for auditing data reuse and evaluation sensitivity, using Capsule Vision 2024 as a case study. It combines measurements of data relationships with two comparisons: changing the evaluation population while holding predictions fixed, and changing training data while holding evaluation fixed. Byte-identical files cross the public training-validation boundary, and all 41 Kvasir-Capsule recordings that contribute frames occur in both partitions. Shared source recordings establish cross-split overlap; missing cross-recording patient identifiers prevent counting unique shared patients. Across ten paired seeds, removing all training rows attributed to Kvasir-Capsule, plus five rows from other sources flagged as near-matches to it, lowers public-validation balanced accuracy from 82.5% to 61.2%. Evaluating the same fitted models on the validation rows of the other sources reverses the comparison: removal improves balanced accuracy by 1.38 percentage points. The public-validation drop measures sensitivity to source removal, not an amount of leakage-induced inflation. Matched controls show that sample size and class counts alone do not explain the observed score differences. An exploratory experiment removes the training neighbors of validation frames that have close training matches, or equally many distant training rows, and yields a difference-in-differences estimate, relative to matched unflagged frames, of -0.355 percentage points in true-class probability; the paired-t interval for accuracy spans zero. The resulting procedure distinguishes observed reuse from conditional performance sensitivity and specifies the population, class support and uncertainty unit for each conclusion.
zh_abstract: 我们开发了 ReuScope，这是一种用于审计数据重用与评估敏感性的方案，并以 Capsule Vision 2024 作为案例研究。该方案将数据关系的测量与两种比较相结合：在预测保持不变的情况下改变评估人群，以及在评估保持不变的情况下改变训练数据。字节完全相同的文件跨越了公开的训练集—验证集边界，且所有贡献帧的 41 条 Kvasir-Capsule 录像同时出现在两个划分中。共享的源录像确立了跨划分重叠；由于缺少跨录像的患者标识符，无法统计共享的唯一患者数。在十个配对随机种子中，移除所有归属于 Kvasir-Capsule 的训练行，以及来自其他来源、被标记为与其近似匹配的五行，会使公开验证集的平衡准确率从 82.5% 降至 61.2%。在其他来源的验证行上评估相同的已拟合模型，则使比较结果反转：移除后平衡准确率提高 1.38 个百分点。公开验证集上的下降衡量的是对来源移除的敏感性，而不是泄漏所致的虚高程度。匹配对照表明，仅样本量和类别数量不能解释所观察到的得分差异。一项探索性实验移除了与训练集存在近距离匹配的验证帧的训练近邻，或同等数量的远距离训练行，并得到相对于匹配的未标记帧的双重差分估计：真实类别概率为 -0.355 个百分点；准确率的配对 t 区间跨越零。由此形成的流程区分了已观察到的重用与条件性的性能敏感性，并为每项结论明确了人群、类别支持度和不确定性单位。

title: Measuring What Matters: A Causal Reliance Score for Histopathology Image Segmentation
zh_title: 衡量关键所在：组织病理图像分割的因果依赖评分
summary: 提出基于干预的因果启发评估框架及因果依赖评分（CRS），量化分割模型对前景组织与背景/域变化的相对敏感度，并设计隐式反事实增强策略。
key_points: CRS量化模型对前景扰动与背景变化的敏感性
基于受控干预探查虚假相关
设计增强策略鼓励对干扰因素不变
reason: 病理方向有新意的评估方法预印本，证据有限
abstract: Reliable histopathology segmentation requires models that rely on pathology-relevant structures rather than spurious background correlations. In this work, we argue that improving architectures alone is insufficient if models continue to rely on spurious correlations rather than pathology-relevant features. We introduce a causality-inspired evaluation framework based on controlled interventions that explicitly probes model sensitivity to foreground tissue structure and background/domain variation. Building on this, we propose the Causal Reliance Score (CRS), a metric that quantifies the relative sensitivity of model predictions to foreground perturbation versus background/domain variation under controlled interventions. To support this analysis, we design augmentation strategies that act as implicit counterfactual interventions during training, encouraging invariance to nuisance factors while preserving morphology. We demonstrate how these interventions reveal behavioural differences between models that are not captured by standard metrics such as Dice or IoU. While we instantiate our framework using a self-supervised transformer (CAUSE-ViT), the primary contribution of this work is not a new architecture, but a principled intervention-based methodology and evaluation metric for auditing model behaviour in medical image segmentation. Our results suggest that evaluating model behaviour through counterfactual interventions is essential for developing reliable and clinically robust medical image segmentation systems.
zh_abstract: 可靠的组织病理学分割要求模型依赖与病理相关的结构，而不是虚假的背景相关性。在这项工作中，我们认为，如果模型仍然依赖虚假相关性而非与病理相关的特征，那么仅改进架构是不够的。我们提出了一个受因果启发的评估框架，该框架基于受控干预，明确探测模型对前景组织结构以及背景/域变化的敏感性。在此基础上，我们提出因果依赖评分（Causal Reliance Score，CRS），该指标量化在受控干预下模型预测对前景扰动相对于背景/域变化的相对敏感性。为支持这一分析，我们设计了在训练期间充当隐式反事实干预的增强策略，在保留形态的同时促使模型对干扰因素保持不变性。我们展示了这些干预如何揭示模型之间的行为差异，而这些差异无法被 Dice 或 IoU 等标准指标捕捉。尽管我们使用自监督 Transformer（CAUSE-ViT）来实例化该框架，但这项工作的主要贡献并非新的架构，而是一种有原则的、基于干预的方法学和评估指标，用于审计医学图像分割中的模型行为。我们的结果表明，通过反事实干预评估模型行为，对于开发可靠且临床上稳健的医学图像分割系统至关重要。

title: Different Models, Shared Failures: Auditing Frozen-Encoder Pools for Medical Segmentation
zh_title: 不同模型、共同失败：医学分割冻结编码器池的审计
summary: CoFailMed对11个公开预训练编码器在5项2D医学分割任务上的相关失败进行审计，发现同一检查点及同族编码器的失败相关性更高。
key_points: 评估11个公开预训练编码器，扩展至17个
同检查点配对的逐例Dice相关性最高
同族不同检查点仍比跨族更相关
reason: 有新意的审计分析，预印本，仅2D任务，属值得一看档
abstract: Average segmentation accuracy and model count do not reveal whether models fail on the same cases. We present CoFailMed, an audit of correlated failures in pretrained-encoder pools for medical segmentation. Across five 2D tasks, we evaluate 11 public pretrained encoders (a controlled sample, not a census) using frozen features and separately trained $1\times 1$ readouts with four seeds per encoder. Shared-checkpoint pairs have the highest mean per-case Dice correlation. An expanded 17-encoder analysis shows that distinct checkpoints within the same encoder family remain more correlated than cross-family pairs. At the pooled 33rd-percentile Dice threshold, four-member pools drawn from distinct encoders have mean effective sizes of 1.56-2.92, estimated from failure correlations in pools with enough failures and passes per member. In the primary pool, richer readouts and fine-tuning narrow the Dice-correlation gap between pairs sharing a checkpoint (or the DINOv2-B/S release) and all other pairs. Yet dependence between different encoders can increase, and fine-tuning does not consistently increase effective pool size at 33rd-percentile thresholds recomputed for each training recipe. A smaller between-group gap can coexist with greater dependence. Pool evaluation should therefore report absolute dependence and threshold-specific effective size alongside accuracy and nominal pool size. The CoFailMed release provides aligned per-case traces, analysis scripts and study code to reproduce the central audit results.
zh_abstract: 平均分割准确率和模型数量并不能揭示各模型是否在相同病例上失败。我们提出 CoFailMed，这是一项针对医学分割中预训练编码器池的相关性失败的审计。在五项二维任务中，我们使用冻结特征和单独训练的 $1\times 1$ 读出层（每个编码器四个随机种子），评估了 11 个公开的预训练编码器（为受控样本，而非全面普查）。共享检查点的编码器对具有最高的逐病例 Dice 平均相关性。扩展的 17 个编码器分析显示，同一编码器家族内的不同检查点之间的相关性仍高于跨家族配对。在合并后的第 33 百分位 Dice 阈值下，由不同编码器组成的四成员池的平均有效规模为 1.56-2.92，该数值根据失败相关性估计，所用池中每个成员均有足够数量的失败和通过样本。在主要池中，更丰富的读出层和微调缩小了共享检查点的配对（或 DINOv2-B/S 版本）与所有其他配对之间的 Dice 相关性差距。然而，不同编码器之间的依赖性可能增加，并且在针对每种训练方案重新计算的第 33 百分位阈值下，微调并未持续增加有效池规模。较小的组间差距可与更强的依赖性并存。因此，池评估除报告准确率和名义池规模外，还应报告绝对依赖性和特定阈值下的有效规模。CoFailMed 发布内容提供了对齐的逐病例轨迹、分析脚本和研究代码，以重现核心审计结果。

title: [Current advances and challenges of artificial intelligence in cervical spine surgery].
source: PubMed · Zhonghua yi xue za zhi
zh_title: 人工智能在颈椎外科中的进展与挑战
summary: 综述AI在颈椎外科的影像分析、风险预测和决策支持应用，指出现有研究多为回顾性，并讨论因果推断、数据质量、多中心协作及法律伦理挑战。
key_points: 多数研究为回顾性建模与技术验证
临床可用性与泛化性证据有限
挑战含因果推断、数据质量与多中心协作
reason: 泛泛综述，无新数据，属增量档
abstract: [Zhonghua yi xue za zhi] Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly expanded its applications in medicine, demonstrating potential in imaging analysis, risk prediction, and decision support. Owing to the complexity of disease patterns and the experience-dependent nature of clinical decision-making, AI holds considerable promise in cervical spine surgery. However, most existing studies remain focused on retrospective modeling and technical validation, with limited evidence supporting clinical usability and generalizability. From a clinically driven perspective, this review summarizes the major application scenarios and developmental trends of AI in cervical spine surgery, and highlights key challenges related to causal inference, data quality, multi-center collaboration, and legal and ethical considerations, aiming to provide a rational basis for the standardized application of AI in this field.
zh_abstract: [Zhonghua yi xue za zhi] 人工智能（AI）在医学中的应用迅速扩展，已在影像分析、风险预测和决策支持方面显示出潜力。鉴于疾病模式的复杂性以及临床决策对经验的依赖性，AI 在颈椎外科中具有相当大的前景。然而，现有研究大多仍集中于回顾性建模和技术验证，支持其临床可用性和可推广性的证据有限。本综述从临床驱动的视角，总结了 AI 在颈椎外科中的主要应用场景和发展趋势，并强调了与因果推断、数据质量、多中心协作以及法律和伦理考量相关的关键挑战，旨在为 AI 在该领域的规范化应用提供合理依据。

title: NOTIFY-DISCUSS: Patient and clinician perspectives on opportunistic screening for coronary artery calcification using artificial intelligence.
source: PubMed · American heart journal plus : cardiology research and practice
zh_title: NOTIFY-DISCUSS：患者与临床医生对AI机会性冠脉钙化筛查的看法
summary: 定性研究访谈20名NOTIFY-1参与者（11名患者、9名临床医生），探讨对用深度学习在胸部CT上机会性筛查冠脉钙化的看法。
key_points: NOTIFY-1曾提高他汀处方与冠心病检查
访谈与焦点小组共20人
关注AI态度、结果沟通偏好与障碍
reason: 小样本定性研究，落地经验有一定参考价值
abstract: [American heart journal plus : cardiology research and practice] NOTIFY-1 was a quality improvement study that utilized a validated deep learning algorithm to perform opportunistic coronary artery calcification (CAC) screening on previously acquired non-gated chest CT scans, significantly increasing statin prescribing and coronary artery disease testing. NOTIFY-DISCUSS explored patient and clinician perceptions of this real-world clinical application of an artificial intelligence (AI) tool. Semi-structured interviews and focus groups were conducted with n = 20 NOTIFY-1 participants (n = 11 patients, n = 9 clinicians). All patients had received their incidental CAC results prior to interviews. Topics included attitudes toward AI use in medicine, experiences with this AI-assisted tool, preferences for communicating incidental findings, and perceived barriers to guideline-directed statin prescribing. Transcripts were coded by a qualitative researcher in NVivo and reviewed by a qualitative expert; analysis of transcripts utilized thematic analysis and consensus approaches. Most participants appreciated the notification tool for providing compelling personalized data to support shared decision-making and behavior change around statin initiation. Participants also noted its potential to improve identification of incidental findings and improve health equity. However, several themes indicated concerns: consent to the use of AI tools; data rights, usage, and security; the time-burden of discussing and contextualizing incidental CAC findings; potential for unintended harm; and need for timely notifications. NOTIFY-DISCUSS offered a unique opportunity to assess perceptions of an implemented AI-driven opportunistic cardiovascular screening tool. Concerns around consent, security, burden and unintended harms will be essential to address when designing and deploying future AI tools, and patient perspectives should be included in ongoing monitoring efforts.
zh_abstract: [American heart journal plus : cardiology research and practice] NOTIFY-1 是一项质量改进研究，利用经过验证的深度学习算法，对既往已获取的非门控胸部CT扫描进行机会性冠状动脉钙化（CAC）筛查，显著增加了他汀类药物处方及冠状动脉疾病检测。NOTIFY-DISCUSS 探讨了患者和临床医生对这一人工智能（AI）工具真实临床应用的看法。研究对 20 名 NOTIFY-1 参与者（11 名患者，9 名临床医生）进行了半结构化访谈和焦点小组讨论。所有患者在访谈前均已收到其偶然发现的 CAC 结果。讨论主题包括：对医学中使用AI的态度、对这一AI辅助工具的体验、对沟通偶然发现的偏好，以及对遵循指南开具他汀类药物处方的感知障碍。访谈记录由一名定性研究人员在 NVivo 中编码，并由一名定性研究专家审核；记录分析采用主题分析和共识方法。大多数参与者认可该通知工具，认为它能提供有说服力的个性化数据，以支持共同决策以及围绕启动他汀治疗的行为改变。参与者还指出，该工具有望改善偶然发现的识别并促进健康公平。然而，若干主题反映出担忧：对使用AI工具的知情同意；数据权利、使用与安全；讨论并解读偶然发现的 CAC 结果所带来的时间负担；潜在的意外伤害；以及对及时通知的需求。NOTIFY-DISCUSS 提供了一个独特机会，用以评估对已实施的AI驱动的机会性心血管筛查工具的看法。在设计和部署未来的AI工具时，必须解决围绕知情同意、安全、负担和意外伤害的担忧，并且应将患者的观点纳入持续监测工作。

title: Artificial intelligence guided automated image analysis of endobronchial lesions during white-light bronchoscopy to predict moderate to severe airway bleeding.
source: PubMed · Lung India : official organ of Indian Chest Society
zh_title: 白光支气管镜AI图像分析预测中重度气道出血
summary: 对250例支气管内病变患者，结合临床与镜下特征，用随机森林、XGBoost等机器学习模型预测中重度出血的探索性观察研究。
key_points: 250例患者，探索性观察研究
多因素回归筛选预测因子
比较RF、XGBoost、CatBoost及集成模型
reason: 单中心小样本探索性研究，摘要未见外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Lung India : official organ of Indian Chest Society] Bleeding during flexible bronchoscopy is an important procedural complication, particularly in patients with endobronchial lesions. Early identification of lesions at higher risk may assist bronchoscopists in procedural planning and preparedness. Artificial intelligence (AI)-based image analysis may enable real-time risk stratification during bronchoscopy. In this exploratory observational study, 250 patients with endobronchial lesions undergoing flexible bronchoscopy were analysed. Clinical characteristics, symptoms, bronchoscopic lesion features, and radiological findings were recorded. Procedural bleeding was graded and categorized as nil/mild or moderate/severe. Predictors were identified using Chi-square and multivariate logistic regression analyses. Machine-learning models (Random Forest (RF), XGBoost, CatBoost, and an ensemble classifier) were developed using clinical and bronchoscopic features. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). Of 250 patients, 82.8% were male and 60.4% were smokers. Mild, moderate, and severe bleeding occurred in 58.0%, 37.2%, and 3.2% of cases, respectively. Moderate haemoptysis prior to bronchoscopy ( P = 0.028), upper-lobe lesion location on bronchoscopy ( P = 0.013) and computed tomography (CT) ( P = 0.027), and vascular lesion appearance ( P = 0.046) were independently associated with higher bleeding risk. The ensemble model demonstrated the best performance (accuracy 85.0%, AUC 0.88), with higher recall (0.76) compared with individual models. Clinical and bronchoscopic features can help identify lesions at higher risk of bleeding during bronchoscopy. AI-based models showed promising performance and may serve as real-time intra-procedural decision-support tools. Further multicentre studies with external validation are required.

abstract: [Studies in health technology and informatics] Artificial intelligence systems are increasingly deployed in contexts that serve older adults, yet they are frequently evaluated on the basis of linguistic fluency rather than structural inclusion. This paper argues that current large language model based AI systems fail a fundamental Universal Design test when applied to ageing populations. Two structural failures are identified: the systematic underrepresentation of older adults in training data, and interaction design assumptions calibrated to digitally fluent younger users. These failures produce simulated empathy, a form of linguistically competent but structurally misaligned responsiveness. Drawing on the Timeless pilot, a voice-first AI lifestyle ecosystem designed for older adults, the paper demonstrates how Universal Design principles can be embedded at the level of AI infrastructure through affordance recalibration, pacing modulation, and cross-domain consolidation. abstract: [Acta neuropathologica] Cerebrospinal fluid cytology remains a cornerstone of diagnostic evaluation in infectious, autoimmune, haemorrhagic, and neoplastic disorders of the central nervous system despite advances in neuroimaging, molecular diagnostics, and digital technologies. This narrative review summarises established principles of cerebrospinal fluid cytology, highlights methodological limitations and diagnostic pitfalls, and integrates emerging developments, including automated cell counting, artificial intelligence, and telecytology. Pre-analytical factors are critical determinants of diagnostic accuracy. Delayed sample processing promotes pH-dependent autolysis and substantial cell loss, whereas rapid cytocentrifugation preserves cellular morphology and facilitates reliable assessment. Automated cell counters are increasingly implemented in routine laboratories and offer advantages in settings with limited technical staffing. However, current systems show limited precision in samples with low and slightly elevated cell counts and limited morphological evaluation. Manual chamber counting, particularly in the normal and low-cell-count range, remains the gold standard for quantitative CSF cell assessment, whereas expert microscopic examination remains the reference standard for qualitative cytomorphological assessment. Although the sensitivity of neuroimaging continues to improve, cerebrospinal fluid cytology retains a unique diagnostic role in the detection of infectious and neoplastic conditions and in the evaluation of subarachnoid haemorrhage. Cytological detection of erythrophages, siderophages, and haematoidin crystals can reveal haemorrhage and provide clues to its temporal stage. Overall, cerebrospinal fluid cytology remains a valuable diagnostic tool when integrated with clinical, laboratory, microbiological, immunological, and imaging findings. Careful recognition of common pitfalls is essential. We recommend rapid cerebrospinal fluid processing, routine preparation of cytospin-based stained slides with expert microscopic review, and the implementation of automated or digital methods only within clearly validated workflows.

abstract: [Journal of environmental pathology, toxicology and oncology : official organ of the International Society for Environmental Toxicology and Cancer] Non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) represents the majority of lung cancer cases and remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Early detection, accurate staging, and individualized therapy are crucial for improving patient survival. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have transformed NSCLC care through the automated analysis of imaging, pathology, and molecular datasets. Deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) models, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have demonstrated high accuracy in tumor detection, histologic classification, biomarker prediction (PD-L1, EGFR, KRAS) and prognosis assessment. Integration of the AI with whole slide imaging (WSI), computed tomography (CT), PET/CT and liquid biopsies enables non-invasive tumor characterization, early recurrence detection and prediction of treatment response. Multimodal AI approaches that combine imaging, genomic, and clinical data offer superior patient stratification and personalized treatment planning compared with traditional methods. Beyond diagnosis, AI facilitates therapeutic development through radiomics based nodule classification, multi-omics data interpretation, and drug discovery. Radiomics, in particular, extracts quantitative imaging biomarkers that capture tumor heterogeneity beyond human perception. The AI further supports clinical decision-making in surgery, radiotherapy, and systemic therapy, enhancing workflow efficiency. Despite challenges in data quality, interpretability, and clinical adoption, AI holds significant promise for advancing precision oncology and improving outcomes in NSCLC management.

abstract: [American journal of pharmaceutical education] To identify the competencies that pharmacists need to evaluate, implement, and oversee technology-enabled care and propose a longitudinal framework for developing these competencies within PharmD education. Drawing on the 2025 National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine (NASEM) Pharmacy Workshop, this paper links emerging technologies to new pharmacist roles across clinical, regulatory, managed care, and industry settings. The new technologies demand that pharmacists validate artificial intelligence (AI) recommendations, implement digital therapeutics, apply pharmacogenomic (PGx) data, and interpret real-world evidence (RWE), all of which extend beyond traditional pharmacotherapy training. We propose four longitudinally scaffolded domains: Technical Understanding, Critical Evaluation, Ethical and Professional Stewardship, and Discipline-Specific Application. abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Pediatric cancer immunotherapy has expanded from anti-GD2 antibodies and bispecific T-cell engagers to immune checkpoint inhibitors and chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy. These treatments can produce rapid, nonlinear, and partially overlapping toxicities, including cytokine release syndrome, immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome, infection, prolonged cytopenia, B-cell aplasia, and organ-specific immune-related adverse events. Nurses provide the highest-frequency clinical observations across inpatient, ambulatory, and home settings, yet conventional monitoring often fragments laboratory data, vital signs, neurologic findings, caregiver observations, and patient-reported outcomes. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers a means to fuse these longitudinal signals into individualized risk trajectories. The clinically relevant mechanism, however, is not autonomous prediction; it is a nurse-in-the-loop system in which AI improves temporal sensitivity and prioritization, while nurses verify signal quality, interpret age- and development-specific context, reconcile child-caregiver discordance, activate protocol-based escalation, and maintain accountability. This Mini Review examines how biomarkers, continuous physiological monitoring, electronic patient-reported outcomes, and caregiver-reported behavioral changes can support AI-enabled nursing surveillance during acute immunotoxicity and long-term survivorship. We propose a three-layer framework linking immune-toxicity biology, a multimodal digital phenotype, and nursing counter-regulation. We also discuss workflow integration, alert fatigue, model drift, bias, privacy, and the need for prospective pediatric validation. AI should augment not replace specialist pediatric oncology nursing judgment and should be evaluated by whether it improves timely intervention, symptom burden, family experience, and long-term safety.

abstract: Dementia caregivers' elevated burden is associated with earlier patient institutionalization and greater caregiver morbidity, yet no standardized, objective method exists for detecting burden during routine clinical encounters. We compared four machine learning and AI approaches for detecting caregiver burden in de-identified caregiver-clinician transcripts from the COPE in PACE study using Zarit burden scores. A naive baseline predicting burden in every transcript achieved precision/F1 = 0.40/0.57. LLM prompting achieved precision/F1 = 0.43/0.60. Weak supervision achieved precision/F1 = 0.48/0.58. The fully supervised model, trained on sentence-level labels with only 1.1% burden-positive sentences, achieved precision/F1=0.19/0.25; this result is not directly comparable because of different labels and units of analysis. LLM prompting modestly outperformed weak supervision and naive baseline without fine-tuning, while class imbalance limited fully supervised sentence-level classification. Larger annotated corpora and refined labeling strategies are needed for clinical deployment.

abstract: Objective To develop and evaluate Pheno+, an electronic health record (EHR)-integrated application that streamlines the generation of structured phenotypes for genomic testing and analysis. Materials and Methods We developed Pheno+ as a Substitutable Medical Applications and Reusable Technologies on Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (SMART on FHIR) application embedded within the University of Utah Health EHR. Pheno+ retrieves clinician-selected clinical notes and applies ClinPhen, a natural language processing tool that identifies candidate Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) terms from clinical text. Clinicians review and curate the resulting HPO terms within the EHR. We used an eight case crossover design to compare total workflow time and HPO term counts between Pheno+ and a standard workflow involving physician chart review followed by HPO term selection by a molecular geneticist. In a separate cohort of 17 patients with confirmed monogenic diagnoses, we evaluated the utility of Pheno+-derived HPO terms for diagnostic gene prioritization by comparing Exomiser performance with and without phenotype input. Results Pheno+ reduced mean total workflow time by 66%, from 31.1 to 10.5 minutes (p < 0.001). Exomiser ranked the causative gene first in all 17 cases (100%) using Pheno+-derived HPO terms. Discussion and Conclusion Pheno+ reduced the time and personnel required to generate clinician-curated HPO term lists while producing phenotypes that provided meaningful diagnostic information for downstream genomic analyses. These findings support EHR-integrated, clinician-in-the-loop phenotyping for genomic workflows.

abstract: Objective To evaluate whether complex perioperative electronic health record (EHR) data can be represented within the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) Common Data Model (CDM) while preserving clinically meaningful analytic concepts. Materials and Methods Data from 31,158 consecutive adult elective surgical encounters (October 2015 - September 2025) were extracted from an academic medical center Epic Clarity database. Source concepts required for a postoperative respiratory failure dataset were manually mapped to OMOP using the OHDSI Athena vocabulary and classified by Health Level 7 equivalence categories under strict and lenient criteria. SQL-based workflows reconstructed clinical representations and analytic concepts, which were validated against the native Epic implementation. Results The reference dataset comprised 28 analytic variables derived from 538 source concepts. Under strict criteria, 40.7% of mappings were equal; under lenient criteria permitting clinical equivalence despite terminology or granularity differences, 97.4% were classified as equal. OMOP achieved >99% cohort concordance. Among 31,083 shared encounters, reconstructed analytic variables showed high agreement, with meaningful differences primarily involving vasopressor infusion identification, body mass index selection, and payer assignment; admission source accounted for most discordant cohort assignments. Discussion Concept equivalence alone incompletely characterized analytic interoperability. Reconstruction of clinical representations and analytic concepts from standardized OMOP concepts preserved analytic fidelity despite incomplete exact concept matching. Conclusions Complex perioperative EHR data can be represented within OMOP with high implementation fidelity despite imperfect concept equivalence. Evaluating preservation of clinically meaningful analytic concepts, rather than vocabulary equivalence alone, provides a practical framework for interoperable perioperative research.

title: Questioning the Benchmarks: Hidden Circularity in AQ-10 Autism Screening Datasets

summary: 预印本比较六类模型在三个AQ-10年龄组数据集上的表现，探讨95–99%的高准确率是否源于标签由同一问卷条目阈值定义的数据构造伪影。

abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) screening increasingly relies on machine learning models trained on the AQ-10 and Q-CHAT questionnaire datasets, and these models are widely reported to reach 95 to 99 percent accuracy, so confirming whether that accuracy reflects genuine diagnostic learning is vital. This paper examines whether that accuracy reflects genuine diagnostic learning or is simply an artifact of how the datasets are built. The study compares six model families, namely Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, XGBoost, FT-Transformer, and TabNet, across three UCI AQ-10 age variants: Child (n=290), Adolescent (n=103), and Adult (n=699). Most emphasis is put on separating the behavioral items that define the diagnostic label from the demographic covariates that do not, since the label itself is a threshold applied to those same items. The effectiveness of this separation is measured using a normalized Circularity Index alongside item-only and demographics-only accuracy. Evaluation of the results has shown that item-based accuracy stays at 93.2 to 100 percent even after the pre-computed result score column is removed, while demographics-only accuracy falls to 50.7 to 71.5 percent, at or below the majority-class baseline in every dataset, giving a mean Circularity Index of 0.947. The same pattern is confirmed on two independent domains outside autism screening: DASS-42 depression screening (n=35,481, CI 0.984) and the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (n=39,076, CI 0.896). Lastly, a diagnostic heuristic named AutoCirc is introduced to flag this kind of circularity automatically using mutual information, reproducing the manual Circularity Index on three of five datasets, and a constructive eight-of-ten-item AQ-10 short form is proposed as a practical outcome of the same analysis. The results of the study confirm that high reported accuracy on these datasets reflects the scoring arithmetic of the screening instrument rather than a learned diagnostic pattern, though this does not call the AQ-10 into question as a clinical screening tool when used as intended. Further work shall seek to extend this audit to additional screening instruments, such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7, and to datasets carrying independent clinical diagnosis labels.
zh_abstract: 孤独症谱系障碍（ASD）筛查日益依赖在 AQ-10 和 Q-CHAT 问卷数据集上训练的机器学习模型，这些模型被广泛报告可达到 95% 至 99% 的准确率，因此确认该准确率是否反映真正的诊断学习至关重要。本文考察该准确率是反映了真正的诊断学习，还是仅仅是数据集构建方式造成的假象。本研究比较了六类模型，即逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）、随机森林（Random Forest）、支持向量机（Support Vector Machine）、XGBoost、FT-Transformer 和 TabNet，涉及三个 UCI AQ-10 年龄组变体：儿童（n=290）、青少年（n=103）和成人（n=699）。研究最着重于将定义诊断标签的行为条目与不定义标签的人口统计学协变量区分开来，因为标签本身就是对这些相同条目施加阈值的结果。这种区分的效果通过标准化循环性指数（Circularity Index）以及仅条目和仅人口统计学的准确率来衡量。结果评估显示，即使移除预先计算的结果得分列，基于条目的准确率仍保持在 93.2% 至 100%，而仅人口统计学的准确率降至 50.7% 至 71.5%，在每个数据集中均处于多数类基线水平或以下，平均循环性指数为 0.947。在孤独症筛查以外的两个独立领域中也证实了相同模式：DASS-42 抑郁筛查（n=35,481，CI 0.984）和 Rosenberg 自尊量表（n=39,076，CI 0.896）。最后，本文提出了一种名为 AutoCirc 的诊断启发式方法，利用互信息自动标记此类循环性，在五个数据集中的三个上重现了手动循环性指数，并且基于同一分析提出了一种建设性的十项中取八项的 AQ-10 简版，作为实际成果。研究结果证实，这些数据集上报告的高准确率反映的是筛查工具的计分运算，而非习得的诊断模式；不过，这并不对 AQ-10 按预期用作临床筛查工具的有效性提出质疑。后续工作将致力于把这一审查扩展到其他筛查工具，如 PHQ-9 和 GAD-7，以及带有独立临床诊断标签的数据集。

abstract: [Journal of the Formosan Medical Association = Taiwan yi zhi] Pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PAC) remains the most lethal malignancies, with a 5-year survival rate of only around 12%. The dismal prognosis is largely attributable to late diagnosis, as early PAC is frequently asymptomatic and radiologically inconspicuous. Contemporary international guidelines recommend surveillance for well-defined high-risk groups, particularly carriers of pathogenic germline mutations such as BRCA2, STK11, and CDKN2A, as well as familial pancreatic cancer kindreds. In these settings, endoscopic ultrasound and magnetic resonance imaging are the recommended surveillance modalities. Recent advances in biomarker discovery, including circulating tumor DNA, methylation signatures of cell-free DNA, and extracellular vesicles, have demonstrated encouraging results, particularly when combined with CA19-9. Paraneoplastic phenomena such as pancreatic cancer-associated diabetes and cancer-induced cachexia provide additional opportunities for earlier clinical recognition. Parallel progress has been achieved in artificial intelligence-driven radiomics analysis and deep learning algorithms, which can increase the sensitivity of cross-sectional imaging for small or otherwise occult lesions. The integration of clinical risk stratification, molecular biomarkers, and AI-enhanced imaging represents a promising framework to shift diagnosis toward surgically resectable stages. This review synthesizes the current evidence, highlights recent advances, and discusses practical considerations for physicians to facilitate earlier detection of PAC.

abstract: [The Journal of nursing administration] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly integrating into health care delivery, influencing clinical, operational, and strategic decision-making. Nurse executives must therefore possess competencies that enable informed oversight of AI-enabled systems. This article proposes an AI literacy competency framework for nurse executive practice, adapted from existing AI literacy scholarship and aligned with nursing leadership responsibilities. abstract: This work introduces three lightweight enhancement modules for medical lesion segmentation to improve clinical applicability, particularly under data-scarce and computationally constrained environments. Current mainstream methods struggle with the lack of high-quality annotations for rare pathologies, which often leads to severe morphological distortions during inference, despite achieving seemingly ideal DSC scores. Furthermore, the isolated development of individual segmentation tasks restricts cross-domain methodological innovation, underscoring the need for leveraging shared knowledge across different lesions within the same anatomical region. However, constrained access to historical data and annotations hinders efficient knowledge extraction and triggers catastrophic forgetting when adapting to new classes. To address these challenges, we first propose DT-Morph Combined Loss with continuous spatial pooling to optimize differentiable topological structures and boundary continuity. Second, we introduce 3D Group Prompt, which extracts domain-universal knowledge via curated volumetric image-mask alignment prompts together with text prompts built on SAT baseline. Finally, we replace conventional output layers with Many-to-One Conditional Segmentation Head equipped with synonym-resolved routing, which brings negligible computational cost and enables fast incremental learning for new categories without sacrificing performance on old tasks. Ablation studies on abdominal and extra-abdominal datasets covering both organ and lesion segmentation verify the efficacy of our modules.
zh_abstract: 这项工作提出了三个用于医学病灶分割的轻量级增强模块，以提高临床适用性，尤其是在数据稀缺和计算受限的环境下。当前的主流方法难以应对罕见病变缺乏高质量标注的问题，尽管 DSC 得分看似理想，推理时却常出现严重的形态扭曲。此外，各个分割任务的孤立开发限制了跨领域的方法创新，凸显了在同一解剖区域内利用不同病灶之间共享知识的必要性。然而，对历史数据和标注的获取受限，既阻碍了高效的知识提取，也会在适应新类别时引发灾难性遗忘。为应对这些挑战，我们首先提出带连续空间池化的 DT-Morph 组合损失，以优化可微的拓扑结构和边界连续性。其次，我们引入 3D 组提示（3D Group Prompt），它在 SAT 基线之上，通过精心构建的体数据图像—掩码对齐提示以及文本提示来提取领域通用知识。最后，我们用配备同义词消解路由的多对一条件分割头（Many-to-One Conditional Segmentation Head）取代传统输出层，其计算开销可忽略不计，并能在不牺牲旧任务性能的情况下实现对新类别的快速增量学习。在涵盖器官和病灶分割的腹部及腹外数据集上进行的消融研究验证了我们模块的有效性。

abstract: [Injury] Artificial intelligence (AI) has become increasingly utilized for injury prevention across diverse clinical and community settings including machine learning (ML). This scoping review aimed to synthesize the current literature on the applications and predictive performance of AI across multiple injury prevention domains. This scoping review searched five major databases, including PubMed, Embase, ScienceDirect, ProQuest, and the Cochrane Library, to identify studies evaluating AI applications for injury prevention published through May 2026. Eligible studies included original U.S.-based, English-language research across self-harm and suicide, abuse and violence, fall prevention, and sports injury prediction. Studies were excluded if they lacked measurable prevention outcomes or sufficient methodological detail, or focused on injury treatment rather than prevention, to ensure relevant and interpretable evidence for synthesis. Nineteen studies met the inclusion criteria. ML models generally outperformed or matched traditional screening methods for self-harm and suicide prediction (AUC 0.81-0.82), while multimodal approaches achieved the highest predictive accuracy (AUC 0.90). In abuse and violence prevention, AI predicted intimate partner violence with an AUC of 0.88 and identified cases before formal disclosure. AI also improved fall risk assessment by accurately categorizing patient risk levels, predicting future falls, and mitigating fall injuries through wearable airbag technology. ML models predicted future sports-related injuries (AUC 0.76-0.84), while identifying modifiable risk factors including workload, strength deficits, prior injury burden, and concussion history. ML-based prediction showed promise for risk stratification in self-harm, suicide, intimate partner violence, and recurrent victimization. Additionally, AI predicted fall risk and identified athletes at risk for future sports-related injuries while detecting modifiable risk factors, including workload, prior injury burden, and strength deficits. Although these findings suggest that AI and ML may have potential applications in supporting earlier risk identification, informing targeted prevention strategies, and facilitating more personalized approaches to injury prevention, the limited available evidence warrants careful interpretation.
zh_abstract: [损伤] 人工智能（AI），包括机器学习（ML），在多种临床和社区环境中越来越多地用于损伤预防。本范围综述旨在综合现有文献，总结 AI 在多个损伤预防领域的应用及其预测性能。本范围综述检索了五个主要数据库，包括 PubMed、Embase、ScienceDirect、ProQuest 和 Cochrane Library，以识别截至2026年5月发表的评估 AI 在损伤预防中应用的研究。纳入的研究为美国本土开展的英文原创研究，涵盖自伤与自杀、虐待与暴力、跌倒预防和运动损伤预测。若研究缺乏可测量的预防结局或足够的方法学细节，或关注损伤治疗而非预防，则予以排除，以确保用于综合分析的证据相关且可解释。共有19项研究符合纳入标准。在自伤和自杀预测方面，ML 模型总体上优于或相当于传统筛查方法（AUC 0.81–0.82），而多模态方法的预测准确性最高（AUC 0.90）。在虐待与暴力预防方面，AI 预测亲密伴侣暴力的 AUC 为0.88，并能在正式披露之前识别出病例。AI 还通过准确划分患者风险等级、预测未来跌倒以及借助可穿戴气囊技术减轻跌倒损伤，改善了跌倒风险评估。ML 模型可预测未来的运动相关损伤（AUC 0.76–0.84），同时识别出可改变的风险因素，包括训练负荷、力量不足、既往损伤负担和脑震荡史。基于 ML 的预测在自伤、自杀、亲密伴侣暴力和再次受害的风险分层方面显示出前景。此外，AI 能预测跌倒风险，识别未来存在运动相关损伤风险的运动员，并发现可改变的风险因素，包括训练负荷、既往损伤负担和力量不足。尽管这些发现提示 AI 和 ML 在支持更早识别风险、为有针对性的预防策略提供依据以及促进更个体化的损伤预防方面可能具有应用潜力，但现有证据有限，解读时需谨慎。

abstract: Objective: 22q11.2 deletion syndrome (22q11DS) is the leading genetic cause of palatal anomalies, presenting a heterogeneous spectrum of clinical manifestations that complicates early diagnosis. No study has systematically investigated the co-occurrence of symptoms spanning cardiovascular, neuropsychiatric, craniofacial, immune, endocrine, renal, and familial domains within a single cohort using unsupervised learning methods for 22q11DS stratification. This study proposes a pipeline to identify subgroups and associated symptom patterns from binary clinical data, aiming to improve screening and referral for genetic testing. Design: Cross-sectional, retrospective study comparing three unsupervised clustering frameworks, K-medoids, DBSCAN, and Latent Class Analysis (LCA), followed by association rule mining applied to individuals with confirmed deletion. Setting: Brazilian Database of Craniofacial Anomalies (BBAC), a national clinical registry. Participants: A cohort of 297 individuals with suspected 22q11DS. Main Outcome Measures: Cluster separability (silhouette coefficient), characterization of phenotypic subgroups, and sensitivity/specificity of the current screening protocol stratified by subgroup. Results: LCA achieved the highest cluster separability (silhouette = 0.165), yielding four distinct subgroups: Cardiac-predominant (C0), Craniofacial-palatal (C1), Neurodevelopmental-psychiatric (C2), and Mild- craniofacial (C3). Cluster coherence was confirmed by medical specialists. Quantitative protocol assessment revealed adequate overall sensitivity, with markedly lower performance for C2 and C3, identifying profiles at higher risk of being missed by current screening criteria. Conclusions: These findings provide a data-driven basis for recalibrating symptom weights and referral thresholds, improving sensitivity for underperforming subgroups while reducing unnecessary referrals, optimizing the balance between diagnostic coverage and the financial burden of genetic testing.
zh_abstract: 【目的】22q11.2 缺失综合征（22q11DS）是腭部异常的首要遗传病因，其临床表现谱具有异质性，使早期诊断复杂化。目前尚无研究在单一队列中使用无监督学习方法，系统地探讨涵盖心血管、神经精神、颅面、免疫、内分泌、肾脏和家族等领域的症状共现情况，以对 22q11DS 进行分层。本研究提出一种流程，从二元临床数据中识别亚组及相关症状模式，旨在改进筛查及基因检测转诊。【设计】横断面回顾性研究，比较三种无监督聚类框架——K-medoids、DBSCAN 和潜类别分析（LCA），随后对确认存在缺失的个体应用关联规则挖掘。【场所】巴西颅面异常数据库（BBAC），一个全国性临床登记库。【参与者】297 名疑似 22q11DS 的个体组成的队列。【主要结局指标】聚类可分性（轮廓系数）、表型亚组的特征描述，以及按亚组分层的现行筛查方案的敏感性/特异性。【结果】LCA 的聚类可分性最高（轮廓系数 = 0.165），得到四个不同的亚组：心脏为主型（C0）、颅面-腭部型（C1）、神经发育-精神型（C2）和轻度颅面型（C3）。聚类的一致性经医学专家确认。对方案的定量评估显示总体敏感性适当，但 C2 和 C3 的表现明显较低，提示这些表型被现行筛查标准漏诊的风险更高。【结论】这些发现为重新校准症状权重和转诊阈值提供了数据驱动的依据，可提高表现不佳亚组的敏感性，同时减少不必要的转诊，优化诊断覆盖范围与基因检测经济负担之间的平衡。

abstract: Healthcare increasingly relies on connected medical devices, clinical information systems, cloud services, and distributed-care technologies, creating cybersecurity risks across clinical workflows. AI-enabled capabilities can accelerate vulnerability discovery and attack-path analysis, increasing the need to limit compromise propagation. This paper proposes a clinical-protocol-aware cyber-resilience framework based on bounded clinical micro-networks and controlled interconnections. The framework integrates clinical factors into cybersecurity design, management, and evaluation, covering prevention, containment, and incident response. A parameterized Monte Carlo simulation distinguishes technical cyber exposure from modeled clinical consequence. Experiments investigate architectural connectivity, adversarial capability, security controls, protocol dependency, risk alignment, communication directionality, lifecycle integration, and response timing. Under the simulation assumptions, connected architecture increases mean cyber exposure by 56.3% relative to segmented architecture, while combined prevention and containment reduce exposure by 60.1% relative to no controls. Increasing protocol dependency raises the modeled clinical-impact index from 1.021 to 7.567 without changing mean cyber exposure, demonstrating that technical exposure and clinical consequence can diverge. Risk-alignment experiments further indicate higher modeled clinical impact when greater technical risk corresponds to greater clinical significance. The findings support comparative architectural analysis, not calibrated estimates of real-world cyber risk, control effectiveness, or patient harm. The framework provides a clinical-context-aware approach to security-boundary design, control prioritization, and coordinated containment in connected healthcare environments.
zh_abstract: 医疗保健日益依赖联网医疗设备、临床信息系统、云服务和分布式医疗技术，由此在各临床工作流程中产生了网络安全风险。具备AI能力的工具可加速漏洞发现和攻击路径分析，从而增加了限制入侵扩散的必要性。本文提出一种感知临床协议的网络韧性框架，其基础是有界的临床微网络和受控互联。该框架将临床因素整合到网络安全的设计、管理和评估中，涵盖预防、遏制和事件响应。一项参数化的蒙特卡罗模拟区分了技术层面的网络暴露与建模得到的临床后果。实验考察了架构连通性、对手能力、安全控制措施、协议依赖性、风险一致性、通信方向性、生命周期整合以及响应时机。在模拟假设下，相对于分段架构，联网架构使平均网络暴露增加56.3%；相对于无控制措施，预防与遏制相结合使暴露降低60.1%。提高协议依赖性会使建模的临床影响指数从1.021升至7.567，而平均网络暴露不变，表明技术暴露与临床后果可以出现背离。风险一致性实验进一步表明，当更高的技术风险对应更大的临床重要性时，建模的临床影响更高。这些发现支持架构层面的比较分析，而不是对现实世界网络风险、控制措施有效性或患者伤害的校准估计。该框架为联网医疗环境中的安全边界设计、控制措施优先级排序和协同遏制提供了一种感知临床情境的方法。
